```{r birth_data}
birth_data = read.csv("Raw_data_birth.csv")

birth_data$name = as.character(birth_data$name)

glimpse(birth_data)
summary(birth_data)

plot(birth_data$brix, birth_data$serum_brix, col = ifelse(birth_data$sex == "F", "red", "blue"))

table(birth_data$sex, birth_data$reproduction_method)

birth_data$sexM = as.integer(birth_data$sex == "M")

birth_data$date_of_birth = as.Date(birth_data$date_of_birth)
birth_data$date_when_leaving_elevated_pen = as.Date(birth_data$date_when_leaving_elevated_pen)
birth_data$date_of_weaning = as.Date(birth_data$date_of_weaning)
birth_data$date_of_death = as.Date(birth_data$date_of_death)
birth_data$date_when_sold = as.Date(birth_data$date_when_sold)

birth_data$serum_brix_z = scale(birth_data$serum_brix)
serum_brix_center = attr(birth_data$serum_brix_z, "scaled:center")
serum_brix_scale = attr(birth_data$serum_brix_z, "scaled:scale")

serum_brix_class_levels = c("poor", "fair", "good", "excellent")
serum_brix_class_cuts = c(-Inf, 8.1, 8.9, 9.4, +Inf)
birth_data$serum_brix_class = cut(birth_data$serum_brix, serum_brix_class_cuts, serum_brix_class_levels, right = F)
# based on Lombard et al. (2020)
# lets define excellentt as the reference level
birth_data$serum_brix_class = relevel(birth_data$serum_brix_class, ref = "excellent")
birth_data$serum_brix_class = factor(birth_data$serum_brix_class,
                                     levels = c("poor", "fair", "good", "excellent"))
birth_data$serum_brix_class = ordered(birth_data$serum_brix_class, 
                                      levels = c("excellent", "good", "fair", "poor"))
contrasts(birth_data$serum_brix_class) = contr.treatment(4)

birth_data$serum_brix_observed = as.integer(!is.na(birth_data$serum_brix))
birth_data$serum_brix_class_id = match(as.character(birth_data$serum_brix_class), 
                                       serum_brix_class_levels)
birth_data$serum_brix_class_id[is.na(birth_data$serum_brix_class_id)] = 0L
birth_data$serum_brix_z_fill = ifelse(birth_data$serum_brix_observed == 1,
                                      birth_data$serum_brix_z, 0)

serum_brix_class_cuts_z = (serum_brix_class_cuts - serum_brix_center) / serum_brix_scale
birth_data$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[2]
birth_data$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[3]
birth_data$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[4]

birth_data$brix_z = scale(birth_data$brix)
brix_center = attr(birth_data$brix_z, "scaled:center")
brix_scale = attr(birth_data$brix_z, "scaled:scale")

birth_data$weight_at_birth_z = scale(birth_data$weight_at_birth)
weight_at_birth_center = attr(birth_data$weight_at_birth_z, "scaled:center")
weight_at_birth_scale = attr(birth_data$weight_at_birth_z, "scaled:scale")
```

```{r plot_mi_effect}
# this is a function that plots predictor vs predicted variable including 
# uncertainty measures for the estimated effects as well as for imputed points
# also it standardize our plots for the paper
plot_mi_effect = function(data, model, predictor, response = NULL, subset_var = NULL,
                          conditions = NULL, robust = TRUE, resolution = 100, 
                          point_alpha = 0.5, by = NULL, reference = NULL,
                          contrast_layout = c("all", "separate"), show_by_curves = TRUE,
                          show_contrasts = TRUE, prediction_ndraws = 5000,
                          re_formula = NA, show_imputed = TRUE, dpar = NULL,
                          external_mi_draws = NULL, external_mi_id = NULL,
                          x_label = predictor, y_label = response, show_points = TRUE,
                          x_transform = identity, y_transform = identity, 
                          risk_metric = c("rate", "first_event_risk", "expected_events", "all", "link"),
                          time_varying = NULL, save_csv = TRUE, save_rds = TRUE,
                          curve_scale = c("response", "link"), observed_point_size = 3,
                          imputed_point_size = 3, errorbar_linewidth = 0.6,
                          curve_linewidth = 1.3, axis_title_size = 12, 
                          axis_text_size = 12, plot_text_size = 10, ribbon_alpha = 0.20,
                          save_png = TRUE, output_dir = "out/", show_plot = TRUE,
                          file_name = NULL, png_width = 4.2, png_height = 3.5, 
                          png_dpi = 600, legend_position = "none",
                          # uncertainty of fitted function
                          curve_ci = 0.95, curve = c("mean", "predictive"),
                          # uncertainty of individual imputations
                          imputed_interval = "ci", imputed_ci = 0.95, imputed_sd = 1) {
  
  # ---------------------------------------------
  # Validating arguments
  # ---------------------------------------------
  curve = match.arg(curve)
  curve_scale = match.arg(curve_scale)
  contrast_layout = match.arg(contrast_layout)
  model_label = deparse(substitute(model))
  risk_metric = match.arg(risk_metric)
  
  if (risk_metric %in% c("first_event_risk", "expected_events", "all")) {
    if (response != "disease_event") stop("'first_event_risk' and 'expected_events' require response = 'disease_event'.")
    if (predictor != "tstop") stop("'first_event_risk' and 'expected_events' require predictor = 'tstop'.")
    if (curve_scale != "response") stop("Cumulative health metrics require curve_scale = 'response'.")
    if (is.null(by)) stop("For now, cumulative health metrics require a 'by' variable.")
  }
  
  # allow 95 instead of 0.95
  if (curve_ci > 1) curve_ci = curve_ci / 100
  if (curve_ci <= 0 || curve_ci >= 1) stop("'curve_ci' must be between 0 and 1.")
  if (imputed_ci > 1) imputed_ci = imputed_ci / 100
  if (imputed_ci <= 0 || imputed_ci >= 1) stop("'imputed_ci' must be between 0 and 1.")
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------
  # Getting variables and model terms
  # ---------------------------------------------
  
  # response and brms response identification
  bterms = brms::brmsterms(model$formula)
  is_mv = inherits(bterms, "mvbrmsterms")
  clean_name = function(x, replacement = "_", lowercase = TRUE) {
    if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("")
    x = as.character(x)
    if (lowercase) x = tolower(x)
    
    # Substitui caracteres inválidos pelo replacement
    x = gsub("[^[:alnum:]_.-]", replacement, x)
    
    if (nzchar(replacement)) {
      # Reduz repetições consecutivas do replacement
      x = gsub(paste0("\\", replacement, "{2,}"), replacement, x)
      # Remove o replacement do início e do final da string (trimming)
      trim_pattern = paste0("^\\", replacement, "+|\\", replacement, "+$")
      x = gsub(trim_pattern, "", x)
    }
    x
  }
  
  if (is.null(response)) {
    if (is_mv) stop("'response' must be supplied for multivariate models using ",
                    "the variable name in the data.")
    response = all.vars(bterms$respform)[1]
  }
  
  if (!response %in% names(data)) stop("Response not found in data.")
  if (!predictor %in% names(data)) stop("Predictor not found in data.")
  
  # identify the internal brms response automatically
  if (is_mv) {
    resp_candidates = names(bterms$terms)
    hit = which(clean_name(resp_candidates) == clean_name(response))
    if (length(hit) != 1) stop("Could not uniquely match response '", 
                               response,
                               "' to a brms response. Candidates: ",
                               paste(resp_candidates, collapse = ", "))
    resp_brms = resp_candidates[hit]
    bterms_response = bterms$terms[[resp_brms]]
  } else {
    resp_brms = NULL
    bterms_response = bterms
  }
  
  # helper to extract variables used in addition terms
  get_ad_vars = function(bt, ad) {
    f = bt$adforms[[ad]]
    if (is.null(f) || !inherits(f, "formula")) return(character(0))
    out = all.vars(f)
    if (length(out) == 0) return(character(0))
    out
  }
  
  get_ad_var = function(bt, ad) {
    out = get_ad_vars(bt, ad)
    if (length(out) == 0) return(NULL)
    out[[1]]
  }
  
  
  all_index_vars = if (is_mv) {
    unique(unlist(lapply(bterms$terms, 
                         function(bt) get_ad_var(bt, "index")), 
                  use.names = FALSE))} else { character(0) }
  all_index_vars = all_index_vars[!is.na(all_index_vars) & nzchar(all_index_vars)]
  model_has_index = length(all_index_vars) > 0
  
  # detect subset() and index() automatically
  model_subset_var = get_ad_var(bterms_response, "subset")
  index_var = get_ad_var(bterms_response, "index")
  rate_var = get_ad_var(bterms_response, "rate")
  vint_vars = get_ad_vars(bterms_response, "vint")
  vreal_vars = get_ad_vars(bterms_response, "vreal")
  
  if (is.null(subset_var) && !is.null(model_subset_var)) subset_var = model_subset_var
  
  # ---------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ---------------------------------------------
  # helper funciont to find monotonic vars
  # detect all monotonic predictors directly from the model formula
  find_mo_vars = function(x) {
    vars = character(0)
    walk = function(e) {
      if (is.null(e))
        return(invisible(NULL))
      
      if (inherits(e, "formula")) {
        walk(e[[2]])
        walk(e[[3]])
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      if (is.call(e)) {
        if (identical(as.character(e[[1]])[1], "mo") && length(e) >= 2) {
          vars <<- c(vars, all.vars(e[[2]]))
        }
        
        if (length(e) >= 2) {
          for (i in seq.int(2, length(e)))
            walk(e[[i]])
        }
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      if (is.list(e)) {
        for (el in e)
          walk(el)
      }
      
      invisible(NULL)
    }
    
    walk(x)
    unique(vars)
  }
  
  monotonic_vars = find_mo_vars(model$formula)
  # helper function to standardize curve plot
  make_curve_plot = function(plot_data, x_lab, y_lab, grouped = NULL,
                             legend_title = NULL, horizontal_line = NULL,
                             point_data = NULL, has_mi = FALSE) {
    
    
    p = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_plot, y = estimate_plot))
    
    x_is_discrete = is.factor(plot_data$x_plot) || is.character(plot_data$x_plot)
    
    if (is.null(grouped))
      grouped = "group_plot" %in% names(plot_data) && 
      length(na.omit(unique(plot_data$group_plot))) > 1
    
    if (grouped) {
      p = p + aes(group = group_plot, color = group_plot, fill = group_plot)
    }
    
    
    if (!is.null(point_data)) {
      if ("group_plot" %in% names(point_data)) {
        point_data = point_data[order(!is.na(point_data$group_plot)), ]
      }
      if (show_points) {
        if (grouped && "group_plot" %in% names(point_data)) {
          pt_aes = aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot, color = group_plot)
        } else {
          pt_aes = aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot)
        }
        
        if (x_is_discrete) {
          p = p + geom_jitter(data = point_data[point_data$source == "Observed", 
                                                , drop = FALSE], mapping = pt_aes,
                              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = point_alpha,
                              size = observed_point_size, width = 0.35, height = 0)
        } else {
          p = p + geom_point(data = point_data[point_data$source == "Observed", 
                                               , drop = FALSE], mapping = pt_aes,
                             inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = point_alpha,
                             size = observed_point_size)
        }
        
      }
      
      if (has_mi && show_imputed) {
        imputed_data = point_data[point_data$source == "Imputed", , drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(imputed_data) > 0) {
          if (grouped && "group_plot" %in% names(imputed_data)) {
            imp_aes = aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot, color = group_plot)
            imp_err_aes = aes(x = x_plot, ymin = lower_plot, ymax = upper_plot, 
                              color = group_plot)
          } else {
            imp_aes = aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot)
            imp_err_aes = aes(x = x_plot, ymin = lower_plot, ymax = upper_plot)
          }
          p = p + geom_errorbar(data = imputed_data, aes(
            x = x_plot, ymin = lower_plot, ymax = upper_plot), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            linewidth = errorbar_linewidth, width = 0) +
            
            geom_point(data = imputed_data, imp_aes,
                       inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 1, 
                       size = imputed_point_size, stroke = 1)
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (x_is_discrete) {
      p = p + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_plot, ymax = upper_plot),
                            linewidth = errorbar_linewidth + 1, width = 0.5, 
                            color = "#0072B2", na.rm = TRUE) +
        geom_point(size = observed_point_size + 1,
                   color = "#0072B2", na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      p = p + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_plot, ymax = upper_plot),
                          alpha = ribbon_alpha, na.rm = TRUE) +
        geom_line(linewidth = curve_linewidth, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    if (!is.null(horizontal_line)) {
      p = p + geom_hline(yintercept = horizontal_line, linetype = 2)
    }
    
    p = p + labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, color = legend_title, fill = legend_title) +
      theme_bw(base_size = plot_text_size) +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size, color = "black"),
            axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size, color = "black"),
            legend.position = legend_position,
            legend.title = element_text(size = plot_text_size, color = "black", face = "bold"),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
            plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 1, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "pt"))
    
    poor_color = "#440154"
    fair_color = "#31688E"
    good_color = "#35B779"
    excellent_color = "#FDE725"
    class_colors = c("poor" = poor_color, "fair" = fair_color, 
                     "good"= good_color, "excellent" = excellent_color)
    
    contrast_colors = c("poor - excellent" = poor_color,
                        "fair - excellent" = fair_color,
                        "good - excellent" = good_color,
                        "poor / excellent" = poor_color,
                        "fair / excellent" = fair_color,
                        "good / excellent" = good_color,
                        "poor vs excellent" = poor_color,
                        "fair vs excellent" = fair_color,
                        "good vs excellent" = good_color)
    
    current_groups = na.omit(unique(plot_data$group_plot))
    if (length(current_groups) > 0 && grouped){
      if (any(grepl("vs|-|/", current_groups))) {
        p = p + scale_color_manual(values = contrast_colors) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = contrast_colors)
      } else {
        p = p + scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors)
      }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(point_data) && show_points) {
      y_min_raw = min(max(quantile(plot_data$lower_plot, probs = 0.025,
                                   na.rm = TRUE)*0.9,
                          min(plot_data$lower_plot, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      min(point_data[point_data$source == "Observed",
                                     , drop = FALSE]$y_plot, na.rm = TRUE))
      y_max_raw = max(min(quantile(plot_data$upper_plot, probs = 0.975,
                                   na.rm = TRUE)*1.1,
                          max(plot_data$upper_plot, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      max(point_data[point_data$source == "Observed",
                                     , drop = FALSE]$y_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      y_min_raw = max(quantile(plot_data$lower_plot, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)*0.9,
                      min(plot_data$lower_plot, na.rm = TRUE))
      y_max_raw = min(quantile(plot_data$upper_plot, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)*1.1,
                      max(plot_data$upper_plot, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
    
    p + coord_cartesian(ylim = range(pretty(c(y_min_raw, y_max_raw))))
  }
  
  # helper function to summarize posterior draws
  summarize_draws = function(draws, prob = curve_ci, robust_internal = robust) {
    alpha = (1 - prob) / 2
    res = posterior_summary(draws, probs = c(alpha, 1 - alpha),
                            robust = robust_internal)
    data.frame(estimate = res[, "Estimate"],
               lower    = res[, 3],
               upper    = res[, 4])
  }
  
  # helper function to calculate posterior RR contrasts between by levels
  make_contrasts = function(prediction_draws, curve_data, predictor_grid, 
                            by, by_levels, reference, 
                            contrast_type = c("all", "ratio", "difference", "nnh")) {
    contrast_type = match.arg(contrast_type)
    
    # If all, we will calculate ratio and difference
    if (contrast_type == "all") {
      res_ratio = make_contrasts(prediction_draws, curve_data, predictor_grid, 
                                 by, by_levels, reference, contrast_type = "ratio")
      res_diff  = make_contrasts(prediction_draws, curve_data, predictor_grid, 
                                 by, by_levels, reference, contrast_type = "difference")
      res_nnh   = make_contrasts(prediction_draws, curve_data, predictor_grid, 
                                 by, by_levels, reference, contrast_type = "nnh")
      return(rbind(res_ratio, res_diff, res_nnh))
    }
    
    reference_idx = which(curve_data[[by]] == reference)
    contrast_levels = factor(setdiff(by_levels, reference), levels = by_levels)
    contrast_levels = as.character(na.omit(contrast_levels))
    
    out = lapply(contrast_levels, function(lev) {
      lev_idx = which(curve_data[[by]] == lev)
      
      if (length(lev_idx) != length(reference_idx))
        stop("Prediction grids differ between levels of 'by'.")
      
      draws_lev = prediction_draws[, lev_idx, drop = FALSE]
      draws_ref = prediction_draws[, reference_idx, drop = FALSE]
      if (contrast_type == "ratio") {
        contrast_draws =  draws_lev/draws_ref
        label_symbol = " / "
        prob_gt = colMeans(contrast_draws > 1)
      } else if (contrast_type == "difference"){
        contrast_draws = draws_lev - draws_ref
        label_symbol = " - "
        prob_gt = colMeans(contrast_draws > 0)
      } else if (contrast_type == "nnh") {
        rd_draws = draws_lev - draws_ref
        contrast_draws = 1 / rd_draws
        contrast_draws[is.infinite(contrast_draws)] = NA
        label_symbol = " vs "
        prob_gt = colMeans(rd_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
      summary_res = summarize_draws(contrast_draws)
      
      lbl_contrast = if (contrast_type == "nnh") {
        paste0(lev, " vs ", reference)
      } else { paste0(lev, label_symbol, reference) }
      
      data.frame(predictor_value = predictor_grid, level = lev,
                 reference = reference, contrast_type = contrast_type,
                 contrast = lbl_contrast,
                 estimate = summary_res$estimate,
                 lower = summary_res$lower, upper = summary_res$upper,
                 Pr_gt_null = prob_gt, x_plot = x_transform(predictor_grid),
                 estimate_plot = summary_res$estimate, 
                 lower_plot = summary_res$lower, upper_plot = summary_res$upper,
                 group_plot = lbl_contrast)})
    
    out = do.call(rbind, out)
    row.names(out) = NULL
    out
  }
  
  # helper function to calculate predictor grid
  make_predictor_grid = function(source) {
    x = source[[predictor]]
    x_nonmissing = x[!is.na(x)]
    
    # monotonic predictor
    if (predictor %in% monotonic_vars) {
      if (is.factor(x)) return(factor(levels(x), levels = levels(x), ordered = is.ordered(x)))
      return(sort(unique(x_nonmissing)))
    }
    
    grid_min = min(x_nonmissing) 
    if (predictor == "tstop" && grid_min > 0) grid_min = 0
    if (!is.numeric(x)) stop("Manual prediction currently requires a numeric predictor.")
    
    integer_like = all(abs(x_nonmissing - round(x_nonmissing)) < 1e-8)
    if (integer_like) return(seq(grid_min, max(x_nonmissing), by = 1))
    seq(grid_min, max(x_nonmissing), length.out = resolution)
  }
  
  # helper function that obtains representative value for a covariate
  representative_value = function(x, var_name) {
    # monotonic predictor -> valid observed level
    if (var_name %in% monotonic_vars) {
      if (is.factor(x)) {
        middle = round(median(as.integer(x), na.rm = TRUE))
        middle = max(1, min(middle, length(levels(x))))
        return(factor(levels(x)[middle], levels = levels(x), ordered = is.ordered(x)))
      }
      
      valid_levels = sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
      center = median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      return(valid_levels[which.min(abs(valid_levels - center))])
    }
    
    if (is.factor(x))
      return(factor(levels(x)[1], levels = levels(x), ordered = is.ordered(x)))
    
    if (is.logical(x))
      return(ifelse(any(x == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE), FALSE, TRUE))
    
    if (inherits(x, "Date"))
      return(as.Date(mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE), origin = "1970-01-01"))
    
    if (is.numeric(x))
      return(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    if (is.character(x)) {
      values = unique(x[!is.na(x)])
      if (length(values) > 0)
        return(values[1])
    }
    NA
  }
  
  # helper function that constructs prediction data
  make_curve_data = function(source, predictor_grid, by_levels = NULL) {
    n_grid = length(predictor_grid)
    n_levels = ifelse(is.null(by_levels), 1, length(by_levels))
    curve_data = source[rep(1, n_grid * n_levels), , drop = FALSE]
    curve_data[[predictor]] = rep(predictor_grid, times = n_levels)
    
    # optional factor-by curves
    if (!is.null(by_levels))
      curve_data[[by]] = factor(rep(by_levels, each = n_grid), 
                                levels = levels(source[[by]]),
                                ordered = is.ordered(source[[by]]))
    
    # variables actually used by this response
    all_vars = intersect(all.vars(bterms_response$allvars), names(source))
    exclude_vars = c(response, predictor, by, index_var, subset_var, 
                     all_index_vars, vint_vars, vreal_vars)
    exclude_vars = exclude_vars[!is.na(exclude_vars)]
    covariates_vars = setdiff(all_vars, exclude_vars)
    
    # representative values
    for (v in covariates_vars) {
      value = representative_value(source[[v]], v)
      if (length(value) > 0 && !all(is.na(value)))
        curve_data[[v]] = value
    }
    
    # user-defined conditions override defaults
    if (!is.null(conditions)) {
      conditions_local = as.data.frame(conditions)
      
      if (nrow(conditions_local) != 1)
        stop( "'conditions' must contain exactly one row ", 
              "for manual prediction.")
      
      protected_vars = c(predictor, by, index_var, subset_var)
      vars_to_update = setdiff(intersect(names(conditions), 
                                         names(curve_data)), protected_vars)
      if (length(vars_to_update) > 0) {
        curve_data[vars_to_update] = as.list(conditions[1, vars_to_update, 
                                                        drop = FALSE])
      }
    }
    
    # response placeholder when needed
    observed_response = source[[response]][!is.na(source[[response]])]
    if (length(observed_response) > 0) {
      if (is.numeric(observed_response)) {
        curve_data[[response]] = mean(observed_response)
      } else {
        curve_data[[response]] = observed_response[1]
      }
    }
    
    # subsetted response
    if (!is.null(subset_var)) {
      template_value = data[[subset_var]][
        which(!is.na(data[[subset_var]]))[1]
      ]
      
      if (is.na(template_value))
        stop("Could not obtain a valid value for subset_var.")
      
      curve_data[[subset_var]] = template_value
    }
    
    # rate -> one unit of exposure
    if (!is.null(rate_var) && rate_var %in% names(curve_data))
      curve_data[[rate_var]] = 1
    
    # index support
    for (iv in all_index_vars) {
      if (!iv %in% names(curve_data))
        next
      
      available_index = unique(na.omit(source[[iv]]))
      if (length(available_index) < nrow(curve_data))
        stop("Prediction requires ", nrow(curve_data), " unique values of '",
             iv, "', but only ", length(available_index), " are available.")
      
      curve_data[[iv]] = available_index[seq_len(nrow(curve_data))]
    }
    curve_data
  }
  
  # helper function that creates posterior prediction
  get_prediction_draws = function(curve_data, method, ndraws = NULL,
                                  dpar_local = dpar, draw_ids = NULL) {
    prediction_args = list(object = model, newdata = curve_data, 
                           re_formula = re_formula)
    if (!is.null(resp_brms))
      prediction_args$resp = resp_brms
    
    if (!is.null(dpar_local))
      prediction_args$dpar = dpar_local
    
    if (!is.null(draw_ids))
      prediction_args$draw_ids = draw_ids
    
    if (!is.null(ndraws) && is.null(draw_ids)) {
      if (length(ndraws) != 1 || !is.numeric(ndraws) || is.na(ndraws) || ndraws <= 0)
        stop("'prediction_ndraws' must be NULL or a positive integer.")
      
      ndraws = as.integer(ndraws)
      n_available = posterior::ndraws(model)
      ndraws = min(ndraws, n_available)
      prediction_args$ndraws = ndraws
    }
    
    if (method == "posterior_linpred")
      return(do.call(brms::posterior_linpred, c(prediction_args, 
                                                list(transform = FALSE))))
    
    if (method == "posterior_epred")
      return(do.call(brms::posterior_epred, prediction_args))
    
    do.call(brms::posterior_predict, prediction_args)
  }
  
  # helper function to get predictions for weight, health, brix joint lp
  get_weight_health_brix_draws = function(curve_data, ndraws = NULL,
                                          draw_ids = NULL,
                                          scale_local = curve_scale) {
    
    if (is.null(draw_ids)) {
      n_available = posterior::ndraws(model)
      n_use = if (is.null(ndraws)) { n_available } else { min(as.integer(ndraws),
                                                              n_available)}
      draw_ids = seq_len(n_use)
    }
    
    weight_dpars = c(poor = "weightpoor", fair = "weightfair", 
                     good = "weightgood", excellent = "weightexcellent")
    weight_draws = lapply( weight_dpars, function(dpar_name) {
      get_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, method = "posterior_linpred",
                           ndraws = NULL, dpar_local = dpar_name, 
                           draw_ids = draw_ids)})
    names(weight_draws) = names(weight_dpars)
    class_values = tolower(as.character(curve_data$serum_brix_class))
    
    out = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = nrow(curve_data))
    
    for (lev in names(weight_draws)) {
      idx = class_values == lev
      if (any(idx))
        out[, idx] = weight_draws[[lev]][, idx, drop = FALSE]
    }
    
    if (scale_local == "link")
      out = log(out)
    
    out
  }
  
  # helper function to get prediction draws with by variable
  get_by_prediction_draws = function(curve_data, method, ndraws = NULL,
                                     draw_ids = NULL,
                                     scale_local = curve_scale) {
    
    weight_health_brix = response == "body_weight" && 
      identical(by, "serum_brix_class") && all(c("weightpoor", "weightfair",
                                                 "weightgood", "weightexcellent"
      ) %in% names(bterms_response$dpars))
    
    if (weight_health_brix) {
      return(get_weight_health_brix_draws(curve_data = curve_data, 
                                          ndraws = ndraws, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                                          scale_local = scale_local))
    }
    joint_serum_class = response == "disease_event" && 
      identical(by, "serum_brix_class") && all(
        c("mu", "poor", "fair", "good", "serumbrixmu") %in% 
          names(bterms_response$dpars))
    
    # ordinary brms models
    if (!joint_serum_class) {
      return(get_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, method = method,
                                  ndraws = ndraws, draw_ids = draw_ids))
    }
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # joint Health-Brix model
    # 
    # Poor:      mu + poor
    # Fair:      mu + fair
    # Good:      mu + good
    # Excellent: mu
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    if (is.null(draw_ids)) {
      n_available = posterior::ndraws(model)
      n_use = ifelse(is.null(ndraws), n_available, min(as.integer(ndraws), n_available))
      draw_ids = seq_len(n_use)
    }
    
    eta = get_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, 
                               method = "posterior_linpred", ndraws = ndraws,
                               dpar_local = "mu", draw_ids = draw_ids)
    dpar_map = c(poor = "poor", fair = "fair", good = "good")
    class_values = tolower(as.character(curve_data[[by]]))
    
    for (lev in names(dpar_map)) {
      idx = class_values == lev
      if (!any(idx))
        next
      
      dev = get_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data[idx, , drop = FALSE],
                                 method = "posterior_linpred", ndraws = ndraws,
                                 dpar_local = dpar_map[[lev]], draw_ids = draw_ids)
      eta[, idx] = eta[, idx, drop = FALSE] + dev
    }
    
    if (scale_local == "response")
      eta = exp(eta)
    
    eta
  }
  
  # helper function to sample t1 and t2
  sample_t1_t2 = function(ndraws) {
    # sampling
    data_subset_var = data[data$animal_row_int == 1,]
    measured_days_in_elevated_pen = data_subset_var$days_in_elevated_pen[
      data_subset_var$days_in_elevated_pen_imputed == 0]
    measured_days_when_weaning = data_subset_var$days_when_weaning[
      data_subset_var$days_when_weaning_imputed == 0]
    t1_samples = sample(measured_days_in_elevated_pen, size = ndraws, replace = TRUE)
    t2_samples = sample(measured_days_when_weaning, size = ndraws, replace = TRUE)
    for (s in seq_len(ndraws)) {
      while (t2_samples[s] < t1_samples[s]) {
        t1_samples[s] = sample(measured_days_in_elevated_pen, size = 1)
        t2_samples[s] = sample(measured_days_when_weaning, size = 1)
      }
    }
    list(t1 = t1_samples, t2 = t2_samples)
  }
  
  # helper function that gets time-varying predictions
  # only works for management stage
  get_by_time_varying_prediction_draws = function(curve_data, method, times,
                                                  ndraws = NULL, draw_ids = NULL,
                                                  scale_local = curve_scale) {
    # new datasets and draws for different management stage
    curve_data_1 = curve_data
    curve_data_1$management_stage = factor("elevated_pen", levels =
                                             levels(data_response$management_stage))
    
    curve_data_2 = curve_data
    curve_data_2$management_stage = factor("agrivoltaics_preweaning", levels =
                                             levels(data_response$management_stage))
    
    curve_data_3 = curve_data
    curve_data_3$management_stage = factor("agrivoltaics_postweaning", levels =
                                             levels(data_response$management_stage))
    # making predictions
    curve_data_all = rbind(curve_data_1, curve_data_2, curve_data_3)
    draws_all = get_by_prediction_draws(curve_data_all, method, ndraws, 
                                        draw_ids, scale_local)
    N = nrow(curve_data)
    draws_1 = draws_all[, 1:N, drop = FALSE]
    draws_2 = draws_all[, (N + 1):(2 * N), drop = FALSE]
    draws_3 = draws_all[, (2 * N + 1):(3 * N), drop = FALSE]
    
    # combining predictions
    n_use = nrow(draws_1)
    t_grid = curve_data$tstop
    draws_final = draws_1
    for (s in seq_len(n_use)) {
      idx_2 = which(t_grid >= times$t1[s] & t_grid < times$t2[s])
      idx_3 = which(t_grid >= times$t2[s])
      if (length(idx_2) > 0) draws_final[s, idx_2] = draws_2[s, idx_2]
      if (length(idx_3) > 0) draws_final[s, idx_3] = draws_3[s, idx_3]
    }
    draws_final
  }
  
  # helper function to calculate cumulative probability of first disease:
  # F(t) = 1 - exp[- integral lambda_0(u) du]
  make_first_event_risk = function(rate_draws, time) {
    if (ncol(rate_draws) != length(time))
      stop("rate_draws and time have incompatible dimensions.")
    
    cumulative_hazard = matrix(0, nrow = nrow(rate_draws), ncol = ncol(rate_draws))
    
    if (length(time) >= 2) {
      dt = diff(time)
      for (j in 2:length(time)) {
        # trapezoidal numerical integration
        lambda_bar = 0.5 * (rate_draws[, j - 1] + rate_draws[, j])
        cumulative_hazard[, j] = cumulative_hazard[, j - 1] + lambda_bar * dt[j - 1]
      }
    }
    
    1 - exp(-cumulative_hazard)
  }
  
  # helper function to calculate expected cumulative number of recurrent disease events
  #
  # State:
  #   N(t-) = number of previous disease events
  #
  # The event intensity may change after each event through
  # mo(prior_events).
  #
  # The last state means K or more previous events, and uses
  # the rate estimated for the largest observed prior_events.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  make_expected_events = function(rate_by_state, time) {
    n_states = length(rate_by_state)
    if (n_states < 1)
      stop("rate_by_state must contain at least one state.")
    
    n_draws = nrow(rate_by_state[[1]])
    n_time = length(time)
    
    for (x in rate_by_state) {
      if (!all(dim(x) == c(n_draws, n_time)))
        stop("All state-specific rate matrices must have the same dimensions.")
    }
    
    # K = largest explicitly modelled prior-event state
    K = n_states - 1
    
    # probability of being in each event-history state
    #
    # columns:
    # 1       -> exactly 0 previous events
    # 2       -> exactly 1
    # ...
    # K       -> exactly K-1
    # K + 1   -> K or more
    state_prob = matrix(0, nrow = n_draws, ncol = K + 1)
    state_prob[, 1] = 1
    expected_events = matrix(0, nrow = n_draws, ncol = n_time)
    if (n_time < 2)
      return(expected_events)
    
    dt = diff(time)
    avg_rates = lapply(rate_by_state, function(x) 0.5 * (
      x[, -n_time, drop = FALSE] + x[, -1, drop = FALSE]))
    new_prob = matrix(0, nrow = n_draws, ncol = K + 1)
    for (j in 2:n_time) {
      # average intensity over the interval
      lambda = vapply(avg_rates, function(x) x[, j - 1], numeric(n_draws))
      
      # Expected increment in N(t)
      expected_events[, j] = expected_events[, j - 1] + 
        rowSums(state_prob * lambda) * dt[j - 1]
      
      # Probability of >=1 transition during this small interval
      transition_prob = 1 - exp(-lambda * dt[j - 1])
      
      # update state probabilities simultaneously
      old_prob = state_prob
      
      if (K == 0) {
        # only one state; hazard assumed to remain at state 0
        new_prob[, 1] = 1
      } else {
        # zero previous events
        new_prob[, 1] = old_prob[, 1] * (1 - transition_prob[, 1])
        # exact intermediate states
        if (K >= 2) {
          for (s in 2:K) {
            new_prob[, s] = old_prob[, s] * (1 - transition_prob[, s]) +
              old_prob[, s - 1] * transition_prob[, s - 1]
          }
        }
        
        # final state = K or more previous events
        new_prob[, K + 1] = old_prob[, K + 1] + old_prob[, K] * transition_prob[, K]
      }
      state_prob = new_prob
    }
    expected_events
  }
  
  # helper function to save standardized PNG
  save_plot_file = function(plot, suffix = NULL, risk_metric_local = risk_metric) {
    if (!save_png)
      return(NULL)
    
    if (!dir.exists(output_dir))
      dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    
    output_dir_figs = file.path(output_dir, "figs")
    if (!dir.exists(output_dir_figs))
      dir.create(output_dir_figs, recursive = TRUE)
    
    output_dir_csv = file.path(output_dir, "csv")
    if (!dir.exists(output_dir_csv))
      dir.create(output_dir_csv, recursive = TRUE)
    
    output_dir_rds = file.path(output_dir, "rds")
    if (!dir.exists(output_dir_rds))
      dir.create(output_dir_rds, recursive = TRUE)
    
    # base filename
    if (is.null(file_name)) {
      parts = c(model_label, predictor, response, risk_metric_local, curve_scale)
      clean_parts = vapply(parts, clean_name, character(1))
      clean_parts = clean_parts[clean_parts != ""]
      base_name = paste(clean_parts, collapse = "_")
    } else {
      base_name = sub("\\.png$", "", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
    }
    
    if (!is.null(suffix)) {
      suffix_clean = clean_name(suffix)
      if (nzchar(suffix_clean)) {
        base_name = paste0(base_name, "_", suffix_clean)
      }
    }
    
    file_path = file.path(output_dir_figs, paste0(base_name, ".png"))
    ggsave(filename = file_path, plot = plot, width = png_width,
           height = png_height, dpi = png_dpi, units = "in", bg = "white")
    saved_paths = list(plot = file_path)
    
    plot_data = plot$data
    
    if (save_csv) {
      csv_path = file.path(output_dir_csv, paste0(base_name, ".csv"))
      write.csv(plot_data, file = csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
      saved_paths$csv = csv_path
    }
    
    if (save_rds) {
      rds_path = file.path(output_dir_rds, paste0(base_name, ".rds"))
      saveRDS(plot_data, file = rds_path)
      saved_paths$rds = rds_path
    }
    
    saved_paths
  }
  
  # finding the subset var, if any
  data_response = data
  if (!is.null(subset_var)) {
    if (!subset_var %in% names(data))
      stop("The specified subset variable '", subset_var, "' was not found in 'data'.")
    
    keep = which(as.logical(data[[subset_var]]))
    data_response = data[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  row.names(data_response) = NULL
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Missing-response draws
  #
  # Two possibilities:
  #
  # 1. ordinary brms mi():
  #       Jmi + Ymi are inside the fitted model
  #
  # 2. joint health-brix model:
  #       missing Serum Brix draws were reconstructed externally
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  has_mi = FALSE
  Ymi_draws = NULL
  Jmi = NULL
  
  if (!is.null(external_mi_draws)) {
    # CASE A: externally reconstructed missing values
    if (is.null(external_mi_id))
      stop("'external_mi_id' must be supplied when ",
           "'external_mi_draws' is used.")
    
    if (!external_mi_id %in% names(data_response))
      stop("'external_mi_id' not found in data.")
    
    Ymi_draws = as.matrix(external_mi_draws)
    
    if (is.null(colnames(Ymi_draws)))
      stop("'external_mi_draws' must have column names ",
           "corresponding to external_mi_id.")
    
    data_ids = as.character(data_response[[external_mi_id]])
    
    if (anyDuplicated(data_ids) > 0)
      stop("'external_mi_id' must uniquely identify rows ",
           "in the plotting dataset. Use subset_var if necessary.")
    
    Jmi = match(colnames(Ymi_draws), data_ids)
    
    if (anyNA(Jmi)) {
      missing_ids = colnames(Ymi_draws)[is.na(Jmi)]
      
      stop("Could not match external imputed values for: ", paste(
        missing_ids, collapse = ", "))
    }
    
    has_mi = TRUE
    
  } else {
    # CASE B: normal brms mi()
    
    sdata = brms::standata(model)
    jmi_candidates_all = grep("^Jmi", names(sdata), value = TRUE)
    
    # identify Jmi belonging to selected response
    if (is_mv) {
      response_key = clean_name(resp_brms)
      candidate_key = clean_name(jmi_candidates_all)
      hit = which(grepl(response_key, candidate_key, fixed = TRUE))
      jmi_candidates = jmi_candidates_all[hit]
      
    } else {
      jmi_candidates = jmi_candidates_all
    }
    
    has_mi = length(jmi_candidates) > 0
    
    if (has_mi) {
      if (length(jmi_candidates) == 1) {
        jmi_name = jmi_candidates
      } else {
        response_key = ifelse(is_mv, clean_name(resp_brms), clean_name(response))
        candidate_key = clean_name(jmi_candidates)
        hit = grep(response_key, candidate_key, ignore.case = TRUE)
        
        if (length(hit) == 1) {
          jmi_name = jmi_candidates[hit]
          
        } else {
          n_missing = sum(is.na(data_response[[response]]))
          sizes = vapply(jmi_candidates, function(x) length(sdata[[x]]), integer(1))
          hit = which(sizes == n_missing)
          if (length(hit) != 1)
            stop("Could not identify Jmi uniquely.")
          
          jmi_name = jmi_candidates[hit]
        }
      }
      
      Jmi = as.integer(sdata[[jmi_name]])
      suffix = sub("^Jmi_?", "", jmi_name)
      pattern = ifelse(nzchar(suffix), paste0("^Ymi_", suffix, "\\["), "^Ymi\\[")
      
      Ymi_draws = posterior::as_draws_matrix(model, variable = pattern, regex = TRUE)
      if (ncol(Ymi_draws) == 0)
        Ymi_draws = posterior::as_draws_matrix(model, 
                                               variable = "^Ymi\\[", regex = TRUE)
      
      ymi_names = colnames(Ymi_draws)
      ymi_index = as.integer(sub(".*\\[([0-9]+)\\].*", "\\1", ymi_names))
      Ymi_draws = Ymi_draws[, order(ymi_index), drop = FALSE]
      
      if (ncol(Ymi_draws) != length(Jmi))
        stop("Number of Ymi parameters differs from Jmi.")
    }
  }
  
  # summarizing missing-value posterior
  if (has_mi) {
    ymi_center = if (robust) apply(Ymi_draws, 2, median) else colMeans(Ymi_draws)
    if (imputed_interval == "ci") {
      alpha = (1 - imputed_ci) / 2
      quants = apply(Ymi_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(alpha, 1 - alpha))
      ymi_lower = quants[1, ]
      ymi_upper = quants[2, ]
      interval_label = paste0(round(imputed_ci * 100, 1), "% posterior interval")
    } else {
      ymi_sd_values = apply(Ymi_draws, 2, sd)
      ymi_lower = ymi_center - imputed_sd * ymi_sd_values
      ymi_upper = ymi_center + imputed_sd * ymi_sd_values
      interval_label = paste0("±", imputed_sd, " posterior SD")
    }
  }
  
  # creating plotting dataset
  point_data = data.frame(predictor_value = data_response[[predictor]],
                          observed_value = data_response[[response]],
                          value = data_response[[response]], lower = NA_real_, 
                          upper = NA_real_, source = "Observed")
  if (!is.null(by)) {
    point_data$group_plot = data_response[[by]]
  }
  
  # if model internally imputes missing responses
  if (has_mi) {
    point_data$value[Jmi] = ymi_center
    point_data$lower[Jmi] = ymi_lower
    point_data$upper[Jmi] = ymi_upper
    point_data$source[Jmi] = "Imputed"
  } else {
    # ordinary model:
    # remove rows that cannot be displayed
    point_data = point_data[!is.na(point_data$predictor_value) &
                              !is.na(point_data$value), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  point_data$source = factor(point_data$source, levels = c(
    "Observed", "Imputed"))
  
  # transforming data to plotting scale
  point_data$x_plot = x_transform(point_data$predictor_value)
  point_data$y_plot = y_transform(point_data$value)
  point_data$lower_plot = y_transform(point_data$lower)
  point_data$upper_plot = y_transform(point_data$upper)
  
  # method for fitted function
  if (response == "body_weight") {
    method = "posterior_epred"
  } else if (!is.null(dpar) || curve_scale == "link") {
    method = "posterior_linpred"
  } else {
    method = ifelse(curve == "mean", "posterior_epred", "posterior_predict")
  }
  
  # ==========================================================
  # BY MODE: class-specific curves + posterior contrasts
  # ==========================================================
  if (!is.null(by)) {
    # checks
    if (!by %in% names(data_response))
      stop("'by' variable not found in data.")
    
    if (!is.factor(data_response[[by]]))
      stop("'by' must be a factor.")
    
    if (show_contrasts && curve_scale != "response")
      stop("Contrasts require curve_scale = 'response'.")
    
    if (show_contrasts && curve != "mean")
      stop("Contrasts require curve = 'mean'.")
    
    # use only animals with observed group/class
    by_source = data_response[!is.na(data_response[[by]]), , drop = FALSE]
    by_levels = levels(droplevels(by_source[[by]]))
    
    if (is.null(reference)) {
      reference = if ("excellent" %in% by_levels) {
        "excellent" } else { by_levels[length(by_levels)]} 
    }
    
    if (!reference %in% by_levels)
      stop("'reference' must be one of: ", paste(by_levels, collapse = ", "))
    
    contrast_levels = setdiff(by_levels, reference)
    
    
    # predictor grid
    predictor_grid = make_predictor_grid(by_source)
    curve_data = make_curve_data(source = by_source, 
                                 predictor_grid = predictor_grid,
                                 by_levels = by_levels)
    metrics_to_process = if (risk_metric == "all") {
      c("rate", "first_event_risk", "expected_events", "link")
    } else { risk_metric }
    
    n_available = posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws(model, variable = "lp__"))
    n_use = min(as.integer(prediction_ndraws), n_available)
    draw_ids = seq_len(n_use)
    all_draws = list()
    all_by_plots = list()
    all_by_data = list()
    all_contrasts = list()
    
    needs_cumulative = any(c("first_event_risk", "expected_events")
                           %in% metrics_to_process)
    if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
      if (predictor != "tstop")
        stop("'time_varying' is currently only implemented for predictor = 'tstop'.")
      if (!all(c("tstart", "tstop") %in% names(data_response)))
        stop("Time-varying covariates require tstart and tstop.")
      if (time_varying !=  "management_stage")
        stop("Time-varying only works for management_stage")
      sampled_times = sample_t1_t2(n_use)
    }
    
    if (needs_cumulative) {
      if (!"prior_events" %in% names(curve_data))
        stop("'prior_events' is necessary for cumullative metrics.")
      
      valid_priors = sort(unique(model$data$prior_events))
      max_prior = max(valid_priors)
      rate_by_state_all = vector("list", max_prior + 1)
      for (n_previous in valid_priors) {
        state_data = curve_data
        state_data$prior_events = n_previous
        rate_by_state_all[[n_previous + 1]] = if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
          get_by_time_varying_prediction_draws(curve_data = state_data, 
                                               times = sampled_times,
                                               method = "posterior_epred",
                                               draw_ids = draw_ids)
        } else {
          get_by_prediction_draws(curve_data = state_data, method = "posterior_epred",
                                  draw_ids = draw_ids)
        }
      }
    }
    
    for (m in metrics_to_process) {
      current_method = method
      if (m == "link") {
        current_method = "posterior_linpred"
      } else if (m == "rate") {
        current_method = "posterior_epred"
      }
      if (m == "rate") {
        draws_m = if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
          get_by_time_varying_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, 
                                               times = sampled_times,
                                               method = current_method,
                                               draw_ids = draw_ids)
        } else {
          get_by_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, method = current_method, 
                                  draw_ids = draw_ids)
        }
      } else if (m == "first_event_risk") {
        rate_draws_zero = rate_by_state_all[[1]]
        draws_m = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(rate_draws_zero), 
                         ncol = ncol(rate_draws_zero))
        
        for (lev in by_levels) {
          idx = which(as.character(curve_data[[by]]) == lev)
          draws_m[, idx] = make_first_event_risk(
            rate_draws = rate_draws_zero[, idx, drop = FALSE], 
            time = predictor_grid)
        }
      } else if (m == "expected_events") {
        draws_m = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_use, ncol = nrow(curve_data))
        
        for (lev in by_levels) {
          idx = which(as.character(curve_data[[by]]) == lev)
          rate_by_state = lapply(rate_by_state_all, function(x) x[, idx, drop = FALSE])
          
          draws_m[, idx] = make_expected_events(rate_by_state = rate_by_state, 
                                                time = predictor_grid)
        }
      } else if (m == "link") {
        draws_m = if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
          get_by_time_varying_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, 
                                               times = sampled_times,
                                               method = current_method,
                                               draw_ids = draw_ids,
                                               scale_local = "link")
        } else {
          get_by_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data, method = current_method, 
                                  draw_ids = draw_ids, scale_local = "link")
        }
      }
      curve_summary = summarize_draws(draws_m)
      by_data = data.frame(predictor_value = curve_data[[predictor]],
                           by_level = curve_data[[by]],
                           estimate = curve_summary$estimate,
                           lower = curve_summary$lower,
                           upper = curve_summary$upper)
      by_data$x_plot = x_transform(by_data$predictor_value)
      by_data$estimate_plot = y_transform(by_data$estimate)
      by_data$lower_plot = y_transform(by_data$lower)
      by_data$upper_plot = y_transform(by_data$upper)
      by_data$group_plot = by_data$by_level
      
      current_y_label = if (is.list(y_label)) y_label[[m]] else y_label
      current_point_data = if (m == "rate") point_data else NULL
      by_plot = make_curve_plot(plot_data = by_data, x_lab = x_label, 
                                y_lab = current_y_label, grouped = TRUE, 
                                legend_title = by, 
                                point_data = current_point_data,
                                has_mi = has_mi)
      # Store main curve objects
      all_draws[[m]]    = draws_m
      all_by_data[[m]]  = by_data
      all_by_plots[[m]] = by_plot
      
      # contrast plots
      # can_calculate_contrasts = curve_scale == "response" && curve == "mean"
      can_calculate_contrasts = TRUE # it will be true anyways
      contrast_results = list()
      
      if (can_calculate_contrasts && show_contrasts) {
        # types of contrasts to compute for metric m
        c_types = c("ratio", "difference")
        if (m == "first_event_risk") c_types = c(c_types, "nnh")
        
        for (ct in c_types) {
          c_data = make_contrasts(prediction_draws = draws_m, 
                                  curve_data = curve_data, 
                                  predictor_grid = predictor_grid,
                                  by = by, by_levels = by_levels, 
                                  reference = reference, contrast_type = ct)
          y_label_contrast = switch(ct, "ratio" = paste0("Ratio "),
                                    "difference" = paste0("Diff "),
                                    "nnh" = paste0("NNH of "))
          y_label_final = paste0(y_label_contrast, y_label[[m]])
          h_line = switch(ct, "ratio" = 1, "difference" = 0, "nnh" = NULL)
          if (contrast_layout == "all") {
            c_plot = make_curve_plot(plot_data = c_data,  x_lab = x_label,
                                     y_lab = y_label_final, grouped = TRUE, 
                                     legend_title = "Contrast",
                                     horizontal_line = h_line)
          } else {
            c_plot = lapply(contrast_levels, function(lev) {
              d = c_data[c_data$level == lev, , drop = FALSE]
              make_curve_plot(plot_data = d, x_lab = x_label, 
                              y_lab = y_label_final,
                              grouped = FALSE, horizontal_line = h_line)
            })
            names(c_plot) = contrast_levels
          }
          contrast_results[[ct]] = list(data = c_data, plots = c_plot)
          if (show_plot && show_by_curves)
            if (contrast_layout == "all") print(c_plot) else lapply(c_plot, print)
          
          suffix_plot = if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
            paste0("by_", by, "_time_varying_", time_varying, "_contrast_", ct, "_", m)
          } else {paste0("by_", by, "_contrast_", ct, "_", m)}
          if (contrast_layout == "all") {
            save_plot_file(c_plot, suffix = suffix_plot)
          } else {
            for (lev in names(c_plot)) {
              save_plot_file(c_plot[[lev]], suffix = suffix_plot)
            }
          }
        }
      }
      all_contrasts[[m]] = contrast_results
      
      if (show_plot && show_by_curves) print(by_plot)
      suffix_plot = if (!is.null(time_varying)) {
        paste0("by_", by, "_time_varying_", time_varying, "_", m)
      } else {paste0("by_", by, "_", m)}
      save_plot_file(by_plot, suffix = suffix_plot)
    }
    # return and STOP here
    return(invisible(list(plots = all_by_plots, contrasts = all_contrasts,
                          data = all_by_data, draws = all_draws, by = by,
                          reference = reference)))
  }
  
  # ==========================================================
  # ordinary responses: conditional_effects()
  # by == NULL
  # ==========================================================
  
  is_joint_serum_health = response == "disease_event" && 
    predictor == "serum_brix_z" && all(
      c("poor", "fair", "good", "serumbrixmu") %in% names(bterms_response$dpars))
  
  if (is_joint_serum_health) {
    # hierarchical serum and health model
    predictor_grid = make_predictor_grid(data_response)
    curve_data = make_curve_data(source = data_response, predictor_grid = predictor_grid)
    cut_vars = paste0("serum_brix_class_cuts_z_", 1:3)
    cuts = vapply(cut_vars, function(v) unique(na.omit(data[[v]]))[1], numeric(1))
    
    # 1 Poor, 2 Fair, 3 Good, 4 Excellent
    class_id = findInterval(predictor_grid, cuts) + 1
    
    # baseline
    eta = get_prediction_draws(curve_data, method = "posterior_linpred", 
                               dpar_local = "mu")
    # class-specific deviations
    dpars = c("poor", "fair", "good")
    
    for (k in 1:3) {
      idx = class_id == k
      if (any(idx)) {
        deviation = get_prediction_draws(curve_data, method = "posterior_linpred",
                                         dpar_local = dpars[k])
        eta[, idx] = eta[, idx, drop = FALSE] + deviation[, idx, drop = FALSE]
      }
    }
    
    # response or link scale
    if (curve_scale == "response")
      eta = exp(eta)
    
    class_names = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent")
    effect_summary = summarize_draws(eta)
    effect_data = data.frame(serum_brix_z = predictor_grid, 
                             estimate__ = effect_summary$estimate,
                             lower__ = effect_summary$lower,
                             upper__ = effect_summary$upper,
                             group_plot = factor(class_names[class_id],
                                                 levels = class_names))
    
  } else if (!model_has_index) {
    # traditional brms models
    conditional = brms::conditional_effects(model, effects = predictor, dpar = dpar,
                                            conditions = conditions, prob = curve_ci,
                                            robust = robust, resp = resp_brms,
                                            method = method, resolution = resolution,
                                            re_formula = re_formula)
    if (predictor %in% names(conditional)) {
      effect_data = conditional[[predictor]]
    } else {
      effect_data = conditional[[1]]
    }
    
    effect_data$group_plot = NA
    
  } else {
    predictor_grid = make_predictor_grid(data_response)
    curve_data = make_curve_data(source = data_response,
                                 predictor_grid = predictor_grid)
    prediction_draws = get_prediction_draws(curve_data = curve_data,
                                            method = method)
    effect_summary = summarize_draws(prediction_draws)
    effect_data = data.frame(predictor_grid, 
                             estimate__ = effect_summary$estimate,
                             lower__ = effect_summary$lower,
                             upper__ = effect_summary$upper,
                             group_plot = NA)
    names(effect_data)[1] = predictor
  }
  
  # transform fitted function to plotting scale
  effect_data$x_plot = x_transform(effect_data[[predictor]])
  effect_data$estimate_plot = y_transform(effect_data$estimate__)
  effect_data$lower_plot = y_transform(effect_data$lower__)
  effect_data$upper_plot = y_transform(effect_data$upper__)
  
  # plot
  p = make_curve_plot(plot_data = effect_data, x_lab = x_label, 
                      y_lab = y_label, point_data = point_data, has_mi = has_mi)
  
  # save plot
  file_path = if (save_png) save_plot_file(p) else NULL
  if (show_plot)
    print(p)
  
  invisible(list(plot = p, data = point_data, effect_data = effect_data,
                 imputed_draws = if (has_mi) Ymi_draws else NULL, 
                 Jmi = if (has_mi) Jmi else NULL, has_mi = has_mi, response = response,
                 predictor = predictor, curve_ci = curve_ci,
                 imputed_interval = imputed_interval, imputed_ci = imputed_ci,
                 imputed_sd = imputed_sd,
                 file_path = file_path))
}
```

```{r plot_brix_prob}
plot_brix_prob = function(model, data, predictor, x_label, x_transform, y_label,
                          ci_level = 0.95, curve_linewidth = 1.3,
                          axis_title_size = 12, axis_text_size = 12, 
                          plot_text_size = 10, ribbon_alpha = 0.20,
                          save_png = TRUE, output_dir = "out/", show_plot = TRUE,
                          file_name = NULL, png_width = 4.2, png_height = 3.5, 
                          png_dpi = 600, legend_position = "none") {
  
  model_label = deparse(substitute(model))
  # Grid and new data
  x_vals = data[[predictor]]
  grid_z = seq(min(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE), max(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
  newdata_prob = data[rep(1, length(grid_z)), ]
  newdata_prob[[predictor]] = grid_z
  
  if (predictor == "brix_z") {
    newdata_prob$weight_at_birth_z = 0
  } else if (predictor == "weight_at_birth_z") {
    newdata_prob$brix_z = 0
  }
  newdata_prob$sex = factor("F", levels = c("F", "M"))
  
  # Obtaining predictions
  draws_df = as_draws_df(model)
  is_joint = "serumbrixsigma" %in% names(draws_df)
  dpar_mu = if (is_joint) "serumbrixmu" else "mu"
  var_sigma = if (is_joint) "serumbrixsigma" else "sigma"
  var_nu = if (is_joint) "serumbrixnu" else "nu"
  
  mu_draws = posterior_linpred(model, newdata = newdata_prob, dpar = dpar_mu, re_formula = NA)
  sigma_draws = draws_df[[var_sigma]]
  nu_draws = draws_df[[var_nu]]
  
  c1 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[2]
  c2 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[3]
  c3 = serum_brix_class_cuts_z[4]
  
  # Calculating probabilities
  n_draws = nrow(mu_draws)
  n_grid = length(grid_z)
  
  p_poor = matrix(0, n_draws, n_grid)
  p_not_poor = matrix(0, n_draws, n_grid)
  p_fair = matrix(0, n_draws, n_grid)
  p_good = matrix(0, n_draws, n_grid)
  p_exce = matrix(0, n_draws, n_grid)
  
  for(i in 1:n_draws) {
    mu_i = mu_draws[i, ]
    sig_i = sigma_draws[i]
    nu_i = nu_draws[i]
    
    cdf1 = pt((c1 - mu_i) / sig_i, df = nu_i)
    cdf2 = pt((c2 - mu_i) / sig_i, df = nu_i)
    cdf3 = pt((c3 - mu_i) / sig_i, df = nu_i)
    
    p_poor[i, ] = cdf1
    p_not_poor[i, ] = 1 - cdf1
    p_fair[i, ] = cdf2 - cdf1
    p_good[i, ] = cdf3 - cdf2
    p_exce[i, ] = 1 - cdf3
  }
  
  # Auxiliary function
  get_summary = function(mat, class_name) {
    data.frame(X_Plot = x_transform(grid_z),
               Class = class_name,
               Prob_Mean = colMeans(mat),
               Prob_Lower = apply(mat, 2, quantile, probs = (1 - ci_level)/2),
               Prob_Upper = apply(mat, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - (1 - ci_level)/2))
  }
  
  # obtaining dataframes
  df_prob_plot = rbind(get_summary(p_poor, "poor"),
                       get_summary(p_fair, "fair"),
                       get_summary(p_good, "good"),
                       get_summary(p_exce, "excellent"))
  
  df_prob_plot$Class = factor(df_prob_plot$Class, levels = c("poor", "fair", "good", "excellent"))
  class_colors = c("poor" = "#440154", "fair" = "#31688E", "good"= "#35B779", "excellent" = "#FDE725")
  
  df_poor_not_plot = rbind(df_prob_plot[df_prob_plot$Class == "poor", ],
                           get_summary(p_not_poor, "not_poor"))
  
  df_poor_not_plot$Class = factor(df_poor_not_plot$Class, levels = c("poor", "not_poor"))
  class_colors_not = c("poor" = "#440154", "not_poor" = "#FDE725")
  
  # auxiliary function to plot
  make_plot = function(df, colors, y_title) {
    ggplot(df, aes(x = X_Plot, y = Prob_Mean, color = Class, fill = Class)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Prob_Lower, ymax = Prob_Upper), alpha = ribbon_alpha) + 
      geom_line(linewidth = curve_linewidth) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
      theme_bw(base_size = axis_title_size) +
      labs(x = x_label, y = y_title, color = "Serum Brix Class", fill = "Serum Brix Class") +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size, color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size, color = "black"),
        legend.position = legend_position, 
        legend.title = element_text(size = plot_text_size, color = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = plot_text_size, color = "black"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 1, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "pt"))
  }
  
  # Generatin gplots
  p_all = make_plot(df_prob_plot, class_colors, y_label)
  p_not = make_plot(df_poor_not_plot, class_colors_not, y_label)
  
  # saving and plotting
  if (save_png) {
    if (!dir.exists(file.path(output_dir, "figs"))) dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "figs"), recursive = TRUE)
    
    base_name = if (is.null(file_name)) predictor else file_name
    
    file_all = file.path(output_dir, "figs", paste0(model_label, 
                                                    "_brix_class_prob_", 
                                                    base_name, ".png"))
    file_not = file.path(output_dir, "figs", paste0(model_label, 
                                                    "_brix_class_prob_not_",
                                                    base_name, ".png"))
    
    ggsave(file_all, plot = p_all, width = png_width, height = png_height, 
           dpi = png_dpi, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file_not, plot = p_not, width = png_width, height = png_height, 
           dpi = png_dpi, bg = "white")
  }
  
  if (show_plot) {
    print(p_all)
    print(p_not)
  }
  return(invisible(list(prob_all = p_all, prob_not = p_not)))
}
```

```{r legends_generation}
  caminho_arquivo = paste0("out/figs/legends_horizontal_contrasts_", nome, ".png")

         width = 6, height = 0.8, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r health_brix_ppc}
# get posterior samples (pp_check())
health_brix_ppc = function(fit, dat, ndraws = 100, seed = 0) {
  all_draws = posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
  set.seed(seed)
  draw_ids = sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(all_draws)),
                         min(ndraws, nrow(all_draws))))
  
  # Linear predictors
  
  mu = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "mu", transform = FALSE, 
                         re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = draw_ids,
                         newdata = dat)
  poor = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "poor", transform = FALSE,
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids,
                           newdata = dat)
  fair = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "fair", transform = FALSE,
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids,
                           newdata = dat)
  good = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "good", transform = FALSE,
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids,
                           newdata = dat)
  serum_mu = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "serumbrixmu", transform = FALSE,
                               re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids,
                               newdata = dat)
  
  health_lp = list(poor = mu + poor, fair = mu + fair, good = mu + good,
                   excellent = mu)
  # Scalar Serum Brix parameters
  
  serum_sigma = all_draws$serumbrixsigma[draw_ids]
  serum_nu = all_draws$serumbrixnu[draw_ids]
  
  # Data
  
  y = dat$disease_event
  exposure = dat$interval_duration
  rows_by_animal = split(seq_len(nrow(dat)), dat$animal_idx)
  anchor_rows = which(dat$animal_row_int == 1)
  observed_anchors = anchor_rows[dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor_rows] == 1]
  missing_anchors = anchor_rows[dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor_rows] == 0]
  missing_lookup = rep(NA_integer_, nrow(dat))
  missing_lookup[missing_anchors] = seq_along(missing_anchors)
  yrep = matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = nrow(dat))
  # posterior continuous Serum Brix for missing animals
  serum_mi_z = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = length(missing_anchors))
  colnames(serum_mi_z) = dat$name[missing_anchors]
  # posterior class probabilities for missing animals
  class_prob_joint = array(NA_real_, dim = c(length(draw_ids),
                                             length(missing_anchors), 4),
                           dimnames = list(NULL, dat$name[missing_anchors],
                                           c("poor", "fair", "good", "excellent")))
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Posterior predictive simulation
  # ==========================================================
  
  for (s in seq_along(draw_ids)) {
    for (ii in rows_by_animal) {
      anchor = ii[dat$animal_row_int[ii] == 1]
      stopifnot(length(anchor) == 1)
      
      if (dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor] == 1) {
        # case when Serum Brix is observed
        k = dat$serum_brix_class_id[anchor]
      } else {
        # case whe Serum Brix is missing. We calculate the probability
        # of beloging to each classe of serum brix
        m = serum_mu[s, anchor]
        sigma = serum_sigma[s]
        nu = serum_nu[s]
        c1 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1[anchor]
        c2 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2[anchor]
        c3 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3[anchor]
        F1 = pt((c1 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        F2 = pt((c2 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        F3 = pt((c3 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        class_prob = c(F1, F2 - F1, F3 - F2, 1 - F3)
        class_prob = pmax(class_prob, .Machine$double.xmin)
        class_prob = class_prob / sum(class_prob)
        
        # Likelihood of observed Health trajectory under each possible class
        health_ll = numeric(4)
        for (kk in 1:4) {
          lambda = exposure[ii] * exp(health_lp[[kk]][s, ii])
          health_ll[kk] = sum(dpois(y[ii], lambda = lambda, log = TRUE))
        }
        
        # P(class | Serum predictors + Health)
        
        log_w = log(class_prob) + health_ll
        log_w = log_w - max(log_w)
        w = exp(log_w)
        w = w / sum(w)
        
        j = missing_lookup[anchor]
        class_prob_joint[s, j, ] = w
        
        # sample ONE class for the whole animal
        k = sample.int(4, size = 1, prob = w)
        
        # Draw continuous missing Serum Brix
        bounds = c(-Inf, c1, c2, c3, Inf)
        lower = bounds[k]
        upper = bounds[k + 1]
        p_lower = ifelse (is.infinite(lower), 0, pt((lower - m) / sigma, df = nu))
        p_upper = ifelse (is.infinite(upper), 1, pt((upper - m) / sigma, df = nu))
        u = runif(1, min = p_lower, max = p_upper)
        # protect qt() against exact 0/1
        u = pmin(pmax(u, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
        serum_mi_z[s, j] = m + sigma * qt(u, df = nu)
      }
      
      # Generate complete replicated Health trajectory
      lambda_rep = exposure[ii] * exp(health_lp[[k]][s, ii])
      yrep[s, ii] = rpois(length(ii), lambda_rep)
    }
  }
  y_animal = as.numeric(rowsum(y, dat$animal_idx))
  yrep_animal = t(apply(yrep, 1, \(x) {as.numeric(rowsum(x, dat$animal_idx))}))
  
  serum_y_z = dat$serum_brix_z[observed_anchors]
  serum_yrep_z = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), 
                        ncol = length(observed_anchors))
  
  for (s in seq_along(draw_ids)) {
    serum_yrep_z[s, ] = serum_mu[s, observed_anchors] + serum_sigma[s] * rt(
      length(observed_anchors), df = serum_nu[s])
  }
  
  print(bayesplot::ppc_bars(y, yrep))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(y_animal, yrep_animal))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_ecdf_overlay(y_animal, yrep_animal))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(y_animal, yrep_animal, stat = "mean"))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(y_animal, yrep_animal, stat = "max"))
  
  print(bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_ecdf_overlay(serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z))
  
  invisible(list(y = y, yrep = yrep, y_animal, yrep_animal,
                 serum_y_z = serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z = serum_yrep_z,
                 serum_mi_z = serum_mi_z, class_prob_joint = class_prob_joint,
                 observed_anchors = observed_anchors, 
                 missing_anchors = missing_anchors,
                 draw_ids = draw_ids))
}
```


```{r weight_health_brix_ppc}
# get posterior samples (pp_check())
weight_health_brix_ppc = function(fit, dat, ndraws = 100, seed = 0) {
  all_draws = posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
  set.seed(seed)
  draw_ids = sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(all_draws)),
                         min(ndraws, nrow(all_draws))))
  
  # Linear predictors
  mu = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "mu", transform = FALSE, 
                         re_formula = NULL, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                         newdata = dat)
  poor = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "poor", transform = FALSE, 
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                           newdata = dat)
  fair = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "fair", transform = FALSE, 
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                           newdata = dat)
  good = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "good", transform = FALSE, 
                           re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                           newdata = dat)
  
  serum_mu = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "serumbrixmu", transform = FALSE, 
                               re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, 
                               newdata = dat)
  
  health_lp = list(poor = mu + poor, fair = mu + fair, good = mu + good,
                   excellent = mu)
  
  # scalar serum brix parameters
  serum_sigma = all_draws$serumbrixsigma[draw_ids]
  serum_nu = all_draws$serumbrixnu[draw_ids]
  
  # Linear predictors of weight
  w_poor = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "weightpoor", transform = FALSE, 
                             re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, newdata = dat)
  w_fair = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "weightfair", transform = FALSE, 
                             re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, newdata = dat)
  w_good = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "weightgood", transform = FALSE, 
                             re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, newdata = dat)
  w_exc  = posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "weightexcellent", transform = FALSE, 
                             re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids, newdata = dat)
  
  weight_sigma = all_draws$weightsigma[draw_ids]
  weight_nu = all_draws$weightnu[draw_ids]
  
  g_weight = list(w_poor, w_fair, w_good, w_exc)
  
  # Data
  y = dat$disease_event
  exposure = dat$interval_duration
  rows_by_animal = split(seq_len(nrow(dat)), dat$animal_idx)
  anchor_rows = which(dat$animal_row_int == 1)
  observed_anchors = anchor_rows[dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor_rows] == 1]
  missing_anchors = anchor_rows[dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor_rows] == 0]
  missing_lookup = rep(NA_integer_, nrow(dat))
  missing_lookup[missing_anchors] = seq_along(missing_anchors)
  w_obs = dat$body_weight
  w_subset = dat$body_weight_subset_int 
  
  # outputs
  yrep = matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = nrow(dat))
  wrep = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = nrow(dat))
  # posterior continuous Serum Brix for missing animals
  serum_mi_z = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), ncol = length(missing_anchors))
  colnames(serum_mi_z) = dat$name[missing_anchors]
  # posterior class probabilities for missing animals
  class_prob_joint = array(NA_real_, dim = c(length(draw_ids), length(missing_anchors), 4),
                           dimnames = list(NULL, dat$name[missing_anchors], c("poor", "fair", "good", "excellent")))
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Posterior predictive simulation
  # ==========================================================
  for (s in seq_along(draw_ids)) {
    for (ii in rows_by_animal) {
      anchor = ii[dat$animal_row_int[ii] == 1]
      stopifnot(length(anchor) == 1)
      
      if (dat$serum_brix_observed[anchor] == 1) {
        k = dat$serum_brix_class_id[anchor]
      } else {
        # Brix Prior Probabilities
        m = serum_mu[s, anchor]
        sigma = serum_sigma[s]
        nu = serum_nu[s]
        c1 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1[anchor]
        c2 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2[anchor]
        c3 = dat$serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3[anchor]
        
        F1 = pt((c1 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        F2 = pt((c2 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        F3 = pt((c3 - m) / sigma, df = nu)
        
        class_prob = c(F1, F2 - F1, F3 - F2, 1 - F3)
        class_prob = pmax(class_prob, .Machine$double.xmin)
        class_prob = class_prob / sum(class_prob)
        
        # Likelihood (Health + Weight) for each class
        joint_ll = numeric(4)
        for (kk in 1:4) {
          # Health
          lambda = exposure[ii] * exp(health_lp[[kk]][s, ii])
          health_ll = sum(dpois(y[ii], lambda = lambda, log = TRUE))
          
          # Weight (only where measured)
          weight_ll = 0
          for (row_idx in ii) {
            if (w_subset[row_idx] == 1) {
              ew = g_weight[[kk]][s, row_idx]
              # Log PDF Student-t
              log_pdf = dt((w_obs[row_idx] - ew) / weight_sigma[s], df = weight_nu[s], log = TRUE) - log(weight_sigma[s])
              # Log CCDF (1 - CDF no 0)
              log_ccdf = pt((0.0 - ew) / weight_sigma[s], df = weight_nu[s], lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)
              
              weight_ll = weight_ll + (log_pdf - log_ccdf)
            }
          }
          joint_ll[kk] = health_ll + weight_ll
        }
        
        # P(class | Serum predictors + Health + Weight)
        log_w = log(class_prob) + joint_ll
        log_w = log_w - max(log_w) # to avoid numerical overflow
        w = exp(log_w)
        w = w / sum(w)
        
        j = missing_lookup[anchor]
        class_prob_joint[s, j, ] = w
        
        # sample ONE class for the whole animal
        k = sample.int(4, size = 1, prob = w)
        
        # Draw continuous missing Serum Brix
        bounds = c(-Inf, c1, c2, c3, Inf)
        lower = bounds[k]; upper = bounds[k + 1]
        p_lower = ifelse (is.infinite(lower), 0, pt((lower - m) / sigma, df = nu))
        p_upper = ifelse (is.infinite(upper), 1, pt((upper - m) / sigma, df = nu))
        u = runif(1, min = p_lower, max = p_upper)
        u = pmin(pmax(u, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
        serum_mi_z[s, j] = m + sigma * qt(u, df = nu)
      }
      
      # Generate complete replicated trajectories
      lambda_rep = exposure[ii] * exp(health_lp[[k]][s, ii])
      yrep[s, ii] = rpois(length(ii), lambda_rep)
      
      for (row_idx in ii) {
        if (w_subset[row_idx] == 1) {
          ew = g_weight[[k]][s, row_idx]
          # zero-truncted sampling throuhg inverse-CDF
          p_lower = pt((0.0 - ew) / weight_sigma[s], df = weight_nu[s])
          u = runif(1, min = p_lower, max = 1)
          wrep[s, row_idx] = ew + weight_sigma[s] * qt(u, df = weight_nu[s])
        }
      }
    }
  }
  y_animal = as.numeric(rowsum(y, dat$animal_idx))
  yrep_animal = t(apply(yrep, 1, \(x) {as.numeric(rowsum(x, dat$animal_idx))}))
  
  serum_y_z = dat$serum_brix_z[observed_anchors]
  serum_yrep_z = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(draw_ids), 
                        ncol = length(observed_anchors))
  
  for (s in seq_along(draw_ids)) {
    serum_yrep_z[s, ] = serum_mu[s, observed_anchors] + serum_sigma[s] *
      rt(length(observed_anchors), df = serum_nu[s])
  }
  
  w_obs_flat = w_obs[w_subset == 1]
  wrep_flat = wrep[, w_subset == 1]
  
  print(bayesplot::ppc_bars(y, yrep))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(y_animal, yrep_animal))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_ecdf_overlay(y_animal, yrep_animal))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(y_animal, yrep_animal, stat = "mean"))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(y_animal, yrep_animal, stat = "max"))
  
  print(bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_ecdf_overlay(serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z))
  
  print(bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(w_obs_flat, wrep_flat))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_ecdf_overlay(w_obs_flat, wrep_flat))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(w_obs_flat, wrep_flat, stat = "mean"))
  print(bayesplot::ppc_stat(w_obs_flat, wrep_flat, stat = "max"))
  
  invisible(list(y = y, yrep = yrep, y_animal = y_animal, yrep_animal = yrep_animal,
                 w_obs = w_obs_flat, wrep = wrep_flat,
                 serum_y_z = serum_y_z, serum_yrep_z = serum_yrep_z,
                 serum_mi_z = serum_mi_z, class_prob_joint = class_prob_joint,
                 observed_anchors = observed_anchors, missing_anchors = missing_anchors,
                 draw_ids = draw_ids))
}
```

```{r brix.m1}
brix.m1.formula = bf(serum_brix_z ~ brix_z)
get_prior(brix.m1.formula, data = birth_data, family = student())

                    family = student(),
                    prior = c(prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
                              prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
                              prior(gamma(2, 1), class = "sigma"),
                              prior(gamma(5, 0.5), class = "nu")),
                    chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                    seed = 0, sample_prior = "only",
                    file = "out/brms/brix.m1.prior",
                    file_refit = "on_change", backend = "cmdstanr")

# lets do some prior predictive simulation

pp_check(brix.m1.prior, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)

# seems ok. We can get extremes, which is good, but it seems to overlay nicely with the data. Lets run the model now

# lets see R2
bayes_R2(brix.m1.posterior)

               x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = serum.brix.label)
```
