```{r brix.m4}
                              prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
                              prior(gamma(2, 1), class = "sigma"),
                              prior(gamma(5, 0.5), class = "nu"),
                              prior(exponential(2), class = "sds")),
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.90), # fixing a few divergences
                    chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                    seed = 0, sample_prior = "only", file = "out/brms/brix.m4.prior",
                    file_refit = "on_change", backend = "cmdstanr")


# lets do some prior predictive simulation
pp_check(brix.m4.prior, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(brix.m4.prior, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)

# seems ok. We can get extremes, which is good, but it seems to overlay nicely with the data. Lets run the model now

brix.m4.posterior = update(brix.m4.prior, sample_prior = "no",
                           file = "out/brms/brix.m4.posterior", cores = 4, seed = 0)

# Lets examine
summary(brix.m4.posterior)
# seems ok. R_hat = 1.00 for all and effective number of samples > 400 for all. Lets see the distributions and see rstan diagnoses
plot(brix.m4.posterior, ask = F)
rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics(brix.m4.posterior$fit)
# 5 transitions. seems ok. Lets get posterior samples
pp_check(brix.m4.posterior, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(brix.m4.posterior, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)
# lets see R2
bayes_R2(brix.m4.posterior)
# that is low, but I can live with it


brix.m4.posterior.loo.model = loo(brix.m4.posterior)
print(brix.m4.posterior.loo.model)
plot(brix.m4.posterior.loo.model)
nobs(brix.m4.posterior)
nobs(brix.m1.posterior)
loo_compare(brix.m1.posterior.loo.model, brix.m4.posterior.loo.model)
# model 1 is still better, but it neglects the effects of weight, sex and smooth for brix
# I will work with this model to include the uncertainty of these parameters

# lets see the conditional effects
plot_mi_effect(data = birth_data,
               model = brix.m4.posterior, predictor = "brix_z", response = "serum_brix_z",
               x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center,
               y_transform = function(y) y * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,
               x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = serum.brix.label)
# we could fit a linear line in the confidence interval, but I do believe in the plataou

plot_mi_effect(data = birth_data,
               model = brix.m4.posterior, predictor = "weight_at_birth_z", response = "serum_brix_z",
               x_transform = function(x) x * weight_at_birth_scale + weight_at_birth_center,
               y_transform = function(y) y * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,
               x_label = weight.at.birth.label, y_label = serum.brix.label)

# lets plot the probability of belonging to a serum brix class
plot_brix_prob(model = brix.m4.posterior, 
                data = birth_data, 
                predictor = "brix_z", 
                x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = prob.label,
                x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center)


# lets plot the probability of belonging to a serum brix class
plot_brix_prob(model = brix.m4.posterior, 
                data = birth_data, 
                predictor = "brix_z", 
                x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = prob.label,
                x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center)

# we basically have a null effect
```

```{r check_spline_k_brix}
k_test_results = list()

for (k_val in 3:10) {
  form_str = paste0("serum_brix_z ~ s(brix_z, k = ", k_val, ") + ",
                    "weight_at_birth_z + sex")
  gam_fit = mgcv::gam(as.formula(form_str), family = mgcv::scat(), data = birth_data)
  k_chk = mgcv::k.check(gam_fit)
  
  # Agregando os resultados desta iteração
  k_test_results[[paste0("k_", k_val)]] = data.frame(
    k = k_val,
    AIC = round(AIC(gam_fit), 1),
    BIC = round(BIC(gam_fit), 1),
    max_edf = round(max(k_chk[, "edf"]), 2),
    min_p_value = round(min(k_chk[, "p-value"]), 3)
  )
}

# Juntando tudo em uma tabela final limpa
k_summary_table = do.call(rbind, k_test_results)
rownames(k_summary_table) = NULL
print(k_summary_table)
# we could have used a line we will remove the spline
```

```{r treatment_data}
# lets start with the following hypothesis:
# p(health event at time t | predictors: serum brix, health history, age, sex, reproduction_method, random effect for the animal itself, if the animal is in the agrivoltaics installation or in someother) - something along these lines, we will test
# first, we need to prepare our dataset. Lets load the health treatment dataset

treatment_data = read.csv("Raw_data_treatment.csv")
glimpse(treatment_data)
summary(treatment_data)

treatment_data$date = as.Date(treatment_data$date)
# for our case, when the animal was weaned, it was kept in the agrivoltaics installation.
treatment_data$place[treatment_data$place == "weaning"] = "agrivoltaics"
```


```{r calf_ped_list}
# We have several missing data on when an animal moved from the elevated pen to the agrivoltaic pen, when weaned, and on brix_serum. We will use a multiple dataset strategy to deal with this uncertainty.
days_in_elevated_pen_idx_na = which(is.na(birth_data$days_in_elevated_pen))
days_in_elevated_pen_n_missing = length(days_in_elevated_pen_idx_na)
birth_data$days_in_elevated_pen_imputed = 0
birth_data$days_in_elevated_pen_imputed[birth_data$days_in_elevated_pen_idx_na] = 1
n_imputing_datasets_days_in_elevated_pen = ceiling(days_in_elevated_pen_n_missing/nrow(birth_data)*100)

days_when_weaning_idx_na = which(is.na(birth_data$days_when_weaning))
days_when_weaning_n_missing = length(days_when_weaning_idx_na)
birth_data$days_when_weaning_imputed = 0
birth_data$days_when_weaning_imputed[birth_data$days_when_weaning_idx_na] = 1
n_imputing_datasets_days_when_weaning = ceiling(days_when_weaning_n_missing/nrow(birth_data)*100)

brix_idx_na = which(is.na(birth_data$brix))
brix_n_missing = length(brix_idx_na)
birth_data$brix_imputed = 0
birth_data$brix_imputed[birth_data$brix_idx_na] = 1
n_imputing_datasets_brix = ceiling(brix_n_missing/nrow(birth_data)*100)
# based on theoretical recommendations--Bodner (2008), von Hippel (2020), and White et al. (2011)--we will define n_imputing_datasets equal to the percentage number of missing data

n_imputing_datasets = max(n_imputing_datasets_days_in_elevated_pen,
                          n_imputing_datasets_days_when_weaning,
                          n_imputing_datasets_brix)
###################################################
# n_imputing_datasets = 5 # for testing
###################################################

# now, lets create the imputation dataset using mice package
vars_to_ignore_birth_data_imputation = c("colostrum_time", "date_when_leaving_elevated_pen",
                                         "daily_weight_gain_in_elevated_pen", "date_of_weaning",
                                         "date_of_death", "date_when_sold", "name", "dam", "sire",
                                         "reproduction_method", "recipient_cow", "colostrum_from_dams",
                                         "date_of_birth", "time_of_birth", "sexM", "serum_brix_z",
                                         "serum_brix_class", "serum_brix_observed", "serum_brix_class_id",
                                         "serum_brix_z_fill", "serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1",
                                         "serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2", "serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3",
                                         "brix_z", "weight_at_birth_z", "days_in_elevated_pen_imputed",
                                         "days_when_weaning_imputed", "brix_imputed")
birth_data_imputation = birth_data[, !names(birth_data) %in%
                                     vars_to_ignore_birth_data_imputation]
birth_data_ignored = birth_data[, vars_to_ignore_birth_data_imputation]
ini_mice = mice(birth_data_imputation, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
pred_mat_mice = ini_mice$predictorMatrix
imputed_obj_mice = mice(birth_data_imputation, m = n_imputing_datasets, maxit = 10, 
                        method = "pmm", predictorMatrix = pred_mat_mice, seed = 0,
                        printFlag = FALSE)

densityplot(imputed_obj_mice, ~ brix | .imp)
stripplot(imputed_obj_mice, brix ~ .imp, pch = 20, cex = 1.2)
densityplot(imputed_obj_mice, ~ days_in_elevated_pen | .imp)
stripplot(imputed_obj_mice, days_in_elevated_pen ~ .imp, pch = 20, cex = 1.2)
densityplot(imputed_obj_mice, ~ days_when_weaning | .imp)
stripplot(imputed_obj_mice, days_when_weaning ~ .imp, pch = 20, cex = 1.2)
plot(imputed_obj_mice, c("brix", "days_in_elevated_pen", "days_when_weaning"))
# they seem fine

A_matrix_imputing_datasets = replicate(n_imputing_datasets, list(A = A_matrix), simplify = FALSE)
set.seed(123) 
calf_interval_list = vector("list", n_imputing_datasets)
for (i in 1:n_imputing_datasets) {
  birth_data_imputed = birth_data
  birth_imputed_cols = complete(imputed_obj_mice, action = i)
  
  # imputing data
  birth_data_imputed$days_in_elevated_pen[days_in_elevated_pen_idx_na] = birth_imputed_cols$days_in_elevated_pen[days_in_elevated_pen_idx_na]
  
  birth_data_imputed$days_when_weaning[days_when_weaning_idx_na] = birth_imputed_cols$days_when_weaning[days_when_weaning_idx_na]
  
  birth_data_imputed$brix[brix_idx_na] = birth_imputed_cols$brix[brix_idx_na]
  birth_data_imputed$brix_z[brix_idx_na] = (birth_data_imputed$brix[brix_idx_na]
                                            - attr(birth_data_imputed$brix_z, "scaled:center"))/
    attr(birth_data_imputed$brix_z, "scaled:scale")
  
  calf_data = merge(birth_data_imputed, treatment_data,
                    by = "name", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE,
                    suffixes = c("_birth", "_treatment"))
  
  calf_data$age_at_treatment = as.numeric(calf_data$date - calf_data$date_of_birth)
  
  # defining the end of the observational period
  calf_data$date_followup_end = pmin(final.observational.date, 
                                     calf_data$date_of_death, 
                                     calf_data$date_when_sold, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  calf_data$max_followup_age = pmin(as.numeric(calf_data$date_followup_end - calf_data$date_of_birth), max.observational.age)
  
  # creating a baseline for each calf
  calf_baseline = calf_data[!duplicated(calf_data$name), ]
  calf_baseline = calf_baseline[calf_baseline$max_followup_age > 0, ]
  # removing information that will be corrected later
  calf_baseline$date = NULL
  calf_baseline$sickness = NULL
  calf_baseline$treatment = NULL
  calf_baseline$days_of_treatment = NULL
  calf_baseline$place = NULL
  calf_baseline$age_at_treatment = NULL
  calf_baseline$housing_stage = NULL
  calf_baseline$weaned_at_treatment = NULL
  calf_data = calf_data[calf_data$name %in% calf_baseline$name, ]
  
  # merging
  calf_interval_data = tmerge(
    data1 = calf_baseline, 
    data2 = calf_baseline, 
    id = name, 
    tstart = rep(0, nrow(calf_baseline)), 
    tstop = max_followup_age
  )
  
  # lets create transitions for agrivoltaics and weaned
  calf_interval_data = tmerge(
    data1 = calf_interval_data,
    data2 = calf_baseline,
    id = name,
    in_agrivoltaics = tdc(days_in_elevated_pen),
    is_weaned = tdc(days_when_weaning)
  )
  
  # lets add age at health event
  calf_interval_data = tmerge(
    data1 = calf_interval_data,
    data2 = calf_data,
    id = name,
    disease_event = event(age_at_treatment)
  )
  
  # lets clean up
  calf_interval_data$housing_stage = ifelse(calf_interval_data$in_agrivoltaics == 1, 
                                            "agrivoltaics", "elevated_pen")
  
  calf_interval_data$weaned = calf_interval_data$is_weaned == 1
  
  
  # we will create a new factor level for housing*weaning
  calf_interval_data$management_stage = case_when(calf_interval_data$housing_stage == "elevated_pen" ~ "elevated_pen",
                                                  calf_interval_data$housing_stage == "agrivoltaics" & calf_interval_data$weaned == FALSE ~ "agrivoltaics_preweaning",
                                                  calf_interval_data$housing_stage == "agrivoltaics" & calf_interval_data$weaned == TRUE ~ "agrivoltaics_postweaning")
  
  calf_interval_data$management_stage = factor(calf_interval_data$management_stage,
                                               levels = c("elevated_pen", "agrivoltaics_preweaning",
                                                          "agrivoltaics_postweaning"))
  
  calf_interval_data$agrivoltaics_preweaning = as.integer(calf_interval_data$management_stage == "agrivoltaics_preweaning")
  calf_interval_data$agrivoltaics_postweaning = as.integer(calf_interval_data$management_stage == "agrivoltaics_postweaning")
  calf_interval_data$interval_duration = calf_interval_data$tstop - calf_interval_data$tstart
  
  calf_interval_data$name_env = calf_interval_data$name # copying to allow for random effects of calf as well as genetics--brms needs different names
  
  calf_interval_data$in_agrivoltaics = NULL
  calf_interval_data$is_weaned = NULL
  
  
  calf_interval_list[[i]] = calf_interval_data
  
}
glimpse(calf_interval_data)
summary(calf_interval_data)
nrow(calf_interval_data)

# Using the first dataset of the subdivided list
table(Housing = calf_interval_data$housing_stage, 
      Weaned = calf_interval_data$weaned, useNA = "ifany")

# let me separate the data for maximum intervals of time_step_interval_health days for PAMM
cut_points = seq(time_step_interval_health, max.observational.age - 1, by = time_step_interval_health)
calf_ped_list = lapply(calf_interval_list,
                       function(dat) {
                         # subdivide the intervals
                         ped = survSplit(Surv(tstart, tstop, disease_event) ~ .,
                                         data = dat, cut = cut_points)
                         ped$interval_duration = ped$tstop - ped$tstart
                         ped = ped[order(ped$name, ped$tstart, ped$tstop), ]
                         cum_ev = ave(ped$disease_event, ped$name, FUN = cumsum)
                         ped$prior_events = unlist(lapply(split(cum_ev, ped$name), function(x) {
                           c(0, head(x, -1))
                         }))
                         
                         # flag to indicate first appearance of name 
                         # (to not repeat lines in analysis of brix)
                         ped$animal_row = !duplicated(ped$name)
                         ped$animal_row_int = as.integer(ped$animal_row)
                         # now a indicator to what is the first animal_row of each row
                         ped$animal_idx = match(ped$name, unique(ped$name))
                         
                         # flags and changes to allow modeling weight
                         # (to not repeat lines in analysis)
                         ped$body_weight = NA
                         ped$body_weight[ped$animal_row] = ped$weight_at_birth[ped$animal_row]
                         ped$body_weight[ped$tstart == ped$days_in_elevated_pen] =
                           ped$weight_when_leaving_elevated_pen[ped$tstart ==
                                                                  ped$days_in_elevated_pen]
                         ped$body_weight[ped$tstart == ped$days_when_weaning] =
                           ped$weight_when_weaning[ped$tstart == ped$days_when_weaning]
                         ped$body_weight_subset = ped$animal_row | ped$tstart == ped$days_in_elevated_pen | ped$tstart == ped$days_when_weaning
                         ped$body_weight_subset_int = as.integer(ped$body_weight_subset & !is.na(ped$body_weight))
                         ped$body_weight_filled = ifelse(is.na(ped$body_weight), 0.0, ped$body_weight)
                         
                         # we dont have imputations here for body_weight, hence they
                         # are all the same
                         ped$body_weight_z = scale(ped$body_weight)
                         
                         # pre-computing
                         ped$log_interval_duration = log(ped$interval_duration)
                         
                         # preparing indices for Stan fast calculations (I hope so)
                         N_lines = nrow(ped)
                         idx_obs = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1)
                         idx_obs_poor = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 & 
                                                ped$serum_brix_class_id == 1)
                         idx_obs_fair = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 & 
                                                ped$serum_brix_class_id == 2)
                         idx_obs_good = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 & 
                                                ped$serum_brix_class_id == 3)
                         idx_obs_exce = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 & 
                                                ped$serum_brix_class_id == 4)
                         idx_miss = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 0)
                         
                         idx_obs_weight = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                  ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1)
                         idx_obs_weight_poor = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                       ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1 &
                                                       ped$serum_brix_class_id == 1)
                         idx_obs_weight_fair = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                       ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1 &
                                                       ped$serum_brix_class_id == 2)
                         idx_obs_weight_good = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                       ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1 &
                                                       ped$serum_brix_class_id == 3)
                         idx_obs_weight_exce = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                       ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1 &
                                                       ped$serum_brix_class_id == 4)
                         idx_miss_weight = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 0 &
                                                   ped$body_weight_subset_int == 1)
                         
                         idx_obs_anim = which(ped$serum_brix_observed == 1 &
                                                ped$animal_row_int == 1)
                         idx_miss_anim = which(ped$animal_row_int == 1 &
                                                 ped$serum_brix_observed == 0)
                         
                         N_obs = length(idx_obs)
                         N_obs_poor = length(idx_obs_poor)
                         N_obs_fair = length(idx_obs_fair)
                         N_obs_good = length(idx_obs_good)
                         N_obs_exce = length(idx_obs_exce)
                         N_miss = length(idx_miss)
                         
                         N_obs_weight = length(idx_obs_weight)
                         N_obs_weight_poor = length(idx_obs_weight_poor)
                         N_obs_weight_fair = length(idx_obs_weight_fair)
                         N_obs_weight_good = length(idx_obs_weight_good)
                         N_obs_weight_exce = length(idx_obs_weight_exce)
                         N_miss_weight = length(idx_miss_weight)
                         
                         N_obs_anim = length(idx_obs_anim)
                         N_miss_animals = length(idx_miss_anim)
                         N_serum_obs_animals = sum(ped$animal_row_int == 1 & ped$serum_brix_observed == 1)
                         counts = c(N_obs, N_obs_poor, N_obs_fair, N_obs_good, #4
                                    N_obs_exce, N_miss, N_obs_weight, #7
                                    N_obs_weight_poor, N_obs_weight_fair, #9
                                    N_obs_weight_good, N_obs_weight_exce, #11
                                    N_miss_weight, N_obs_anim, N_miss_animals, #14
                                    N_serum_obs_animals) #15
                         
                         # zero padding until size N_lines
                         ped$idx_obs_padded = c(idx_obs, rep(0, N_lines - N_obs))
                         ped$idx_obs_poor_padded = c(idx_obs_poor, rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_poor))
                         ped$idx_obs_fair_padded = c(idx_obs_fair, rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_fair))
                         ped$idx_obs_good_padded = c(idx_obs_good, rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_good))
                         ped$idx_obs_exce_padded = c(idx_obs_exce, rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_exce))
                         ped$idx_miss_padded = c(idx_miss, rep(0, N_lines - N_miss))
                         
                         ped$idx_obs_weight_padded = c(idx_obs_weight, 
                                                       rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_weight))
                         ped$idx_obs_weight_poor_padded = c(idx_obs_weight_poor, 
                                                            rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_weight_poor))

                         ped$idx_miss_weight_padded = c(idx_miss_weight,

                         ped$idx_obs_anim_padded = c(idx_obs_anim, 
                                                     rep(0, N_lines - N_obs_anim))
                         ped$idx_miss_anim_padded = c(idx_miss_anim, 
                                                      rep(0, N_lines - N_miss_animals))
                         ped$counts_padded = c(counts, rep(0, N_lines - length(counts)))
                         ped
                       }
)
```

```{r multiple_imputation_datasets_diagnostics}
multiple_imputation_datasets_diagnostics = function(model, rhat.limit = 1.01,
                                                    ess.bulk.limit = 400,
                                                    ess.tail.limit = 400,
                                                    n_datasets = n_imputing_datasets) {
  draws = as_draws_array(model)
  total_chains = nchains(draws)
  chains_per_dat = total_chains / n_datasets
  draws_per_dat = lapply(1:n_datasets, \(i) subset_draws(
    draws, chain = ((i - 1) *chains_per_dat + 1):(i * chains_per_dat)))
  diagnostics = lapply(draws_per_dat, summarise_draws, default_convergence_measures())
  
  diagnostics.problematic = purrr::imap_dfr(diagnostics, \(x, i) {
    x |> dplyr::mutate(imputation = i) |> dplyr::filter(rhat > rhat.limit |
                                                          ess_bulk < ess.bulk.limit |
                                                          ess_tail < ess.tail.limit)})
  
  diagnostics.problematic |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rhat), ess_bulk) |>
    print(n = Inf)
  
  invisible(diagnostics)
}
```


```{r health.m0}
# lets run our Bayesian model for health events. We will start with only one dataset and will explore the multiple datasets later. Here, we want to validate dataset/formula/etc
health.m0.formula = bf(disease_event | rate(interval_duration) ~
                         s(tstop) + s(tstop, by = serum_brix_class) + serum_brix_class +
                         management_stage + s(weight_at_birth_z) + 
                         s(serum_brix_z) + sex + mo(prior_events) + 
                         (1 | name_env) + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)))
get_prior(health.m0.formula, data = calf_ped_list[[1]], data2 = list(A = A_matrix), family = poisson())
health.m0.priors = c(prior(normal(log(0.01), 1), class = "Intercept"),
                     prior(normal(0, 0.7), class = "b"),
                     prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
                     prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"))
health.m0.test = brm(formula = health.m0.formula,
                     data = calf_ped_list[[1]], data2 = list(A = A_matrix),
                     family = poisson(), prior = health.m0.priors,
                     chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 0,
                     iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                     file = "out/brms/health.m0.test", file_refit = "on_change",
                     control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), # fixing a few divergences
                     backend = "cmdstanr", stan_model_args = stan_optimization_flags)
summary(health.m0.test)
pp_check(health.m0.test)
VarCorr(health.m0.test)

health.m0.test.loo.model = loo(health.m0.test)
print(health.m0.test.loo.model)
plot(health.m0.test.loo.model)

# lets see what it learned
plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]], risk_metric = "all",
               model = health.m0.test, predictor = "tstop", response = "disease_event",
               time_varying = "management_stage",
               by = "serum_brix_class", reference = "excellent", contrast_layout = "all",
               x_label = tstop.label, y_label = health.by.response.label,
               curve_scale = "response", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],

               x_label = prior_events.label, y_label = health.response.label,
               curve_scale = "response", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = health.m0.test, predictor = "prior_events", response = "disease_event",
               x_label = prior_events.label, y_label = health.link.label,
               curve_scale = "link", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = health.m0.test, predictor = "serum_brix_z", response = "disease_event",

               x_transform = function(x) x * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
```

```{r health.m1.test}
# we will remove name_env as we have seen in furhter tests that it goes to zero
health.m1.formula = bf(disease_event | rate(interval_duration) ~
                         s(tstop) + s(tstop, by = serum_brix_class) + serum_brix_class +
                         management_stage + weight_at_birth_z +

                     prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
                     prior(normal(0, 0.12), class = "b", coef = "moprior_events"),

                     prior(exponential(2), class = "sds"))

health.m1.prior = brm(formula = health.m1.formula,
                      data = calf_ped_list[[1]], data2 = list(A = A_matrix),

                      chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                      seed = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), # divergences

                      stan_model_args = stan_optimization_flags)

                        file = "out/brms/health.m1.test", cores = 4, seed = 0)
```

```{r check_spline_k_health}
k_test_results = list()
k_values = 3:20
for (k_val in k_values) {
  form_str = paste0("disease_event ~ s(tstop, k = ", k_val, ") + s(tstop, by = serum_brix_class, k = ", k_val, ") + ",
                    "serum_brix_class + management_stage + weight_at_birth_z + sex + ",
                    "prior_events + offset(log(interval_duration))")
  
  gam_fit = mgcv::gam(as.formula(form_str), family = poisson(link = "log"), data = calf_ped_list[[1]], method = "REML")
  k_chk = mgcv::k.check(gam_fit)
  
  sm = summary(gam_fit)$s.table
  
  smooth_results = data.frame(k = k_val, smooth = rownames(sm), edf = sm[, "edf"],
                              ref_df = sm[, "Ref.df"], F = sm[, "Chi.sq"], 
                              p_value = sm[, "p-value"], k_index = k_chk[, "k-index"],
                              k_p_value = k_chk[, "p-value"], row.names = NULL)
  
  model_results = data.frame(k = k_val, AIC = AIC(gam_fit), BIC = BIC(gam_fit),
                             deviance_explained = summary(gam_fit)$dev.expl,
                             n = nobs(gam_fit))
  
  k_test_results[[paste0("k_", k_val)]] = list(model = gam_fit, 
                                               smooths = smooth_results,
                                               model_summary = model_results)
}

k_smooth_summary = do.call(rbind, lapply(k_test_results, function(x) x$smooths))
rownames(k_smooth_summary) = NULL
k_model_summary = do.call(rbind, lapply(k_test_results, function(x) x$model_summary))
rownames(k_model_summary) = NULL
print(k_smooth_summary)
print(k_model_summary)

k_compact = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(k_smooth_summary, k_smooth_summary$k),
                                  function(df) {
                                    data.frame(k = unique(df$k),
                                               min_k_index = min(df$k_index, 
                                                                 na.rm = TRUE),
                                               min_k_p_value = min(df$k_p_value, 
                                                                   na.rm = TRUE),
                                               max_edf = max(df$edf, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               max_edf_ratio = max(df$edf / df$ref_df,
                                                                   na.rm = TRUE))}))
rownames(k_compact) = NULL
k_compact = merge(k_compact, k_model_summary[, c("k", "AIC", "BIC")], by = "k", 
                  sort = TRUE)
k_compact = k_compact[order(k_compact$k),]
print(k_compact)

ggplot(k_model_summary, aes(x = k, y = AIC)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "k", y = "AIC")

ggplot(k_model_summary, aes(x = k, y = BIC)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "k", y = "BIC")

ggplot(k_smooth_summary, aes(x = k, y = edf, group = smooth, color = smooth)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "k", y = "EDF", color = "Smooth")

# Base on maximum estimated degrees of freedom, we will define:
# excellent: k = 10
# good: k = 7
# fair: k = 3
# poor: k = 3
```

```{r health.brix.family}
healh.brix.family = custom_family("health_brix",
                                  dpars = c("mu", "poor", "fair", "good",
                                            "serumbrixmu", "serumbrixsigma",
                                            "serumbrixnu"),
                                  links = c(rep("identity", 5), "log", "logm1"),
                                  lb = c(rep(NA, 5), 0, 1),
                                  type = "int",
                                  vars = c(paste0("vint", 1:12), paste0("vreal", 1:5)),
                                  loop = FALSE)
health.brix.stan.code = paste(readLines("stan/health_brix_lpmf.stan", warn = F), collapse = "\n")
health.brix.stanvars = stanvar(scode = health.brix.stan.code, block = "functions")
```


```{r health.brix.m1.test}
health.brix.m1.formula = bf(disease_event | vint(animal_idx, serum_brix_observed,
                                                 animal_row_int, serum_brix_class_id,
                                                 idx_obs_poor_padded, idx_obs_fair_padded,
                                                 idx_obs_good_padded, idx_obs_exce_padded, 
                                                 idx_miss_padded, idx_obs_anim_padded,
                                                 idx_miss_anim_padded, counts_padded) +
                              vreal(log_interval_duration, serum_brix_z_fill,
                                    serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1, 
                                    serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2,
                                    serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3) ~
                              s(tstop) + management_stage  + weight_at_birth_z 
                            + sex + prior_events + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                            good ~ s(tstop, k = 7), 
                            fair ~ s(tstop, k = 3),
                            poor ~ s(tstop, k = 3),
                            serumbrixmu ~ brix_z + weight_at_birth_z + sex,
                            family = healh.brix.family)
get_prior(health.brix.m1.formula, data = calf_ped_list[[1]], data2 = list(A = A_matrix))
health.brix.m1.priors = c(prior(normal(-5.7, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.12), class = "b", coef = "prior_events"),
                          prior(exponential(4), class = "sd"),
                          
                          prior(normal(0.2, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "poor"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "poor"),
                          prior(exponential(4), class = "sds", dpar = "poor"),
                          
                          prior(normal(-0.2, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "fair"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "fair"),
                          prior(exponential(4), class = "sds", dpar = "fair"),
                          
                          prior(normal(-0.2, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "good"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "good"),
                          prior(exponential(4), class = "sds", dpar = "good"),
                          
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "Intercept", 
                                dpar = "serumbrixmu"),
                          prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "serumbrixmu"),
                          prior(gamma(2, 1), class = "serumbrixsigma"),
                          prior(gamma(5, 0.5), class = "serumbrixnu"))

# prior predictive simulation is hard in such complicated model. We will trust the priors validated for
# the simpler models and go straight to the test model

                          stanvars = health.brix.stanvars,

                          data2 = list(A = A_matrix),

                          iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                          seed = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                          file = "out/brms/health.brix.m1.test", file_refit = "on_change",
                          backend = "cmdstanr",
                          stan_model_args = stan_optimization_flags)

# Lets examine

# seems ok. Need to run the full model though
VarCorr(health.brix.m1.test)
plot(health.brix.m1.test, ask = F)

# seems ok. Lets get posterior samples
health.brix.m1.test.ppc = health_brix_ppc(health.brix.m1.test, calf_ped_list[[40]])
# posteriors seem fine
```

```{r weight.m1.test}
# lets start with a complex model
weight.m1.formula = bf(body_weight | + subset(body_weight_subset) + trunc(lb = 0)
                       ~ exp(lW0) + exp(lG) * (1 - exp(-exp(lK) * tstart)),
                       # W0 = initial body weight (W0 > 0)
                       # We will assume that it depends on sex and pedigree
                       lW0 ~ sex + (1 | name_env) + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                       # G = adjusting factor for weight at weaning
                       # W0 + G*(1 - exp(-K * days_at_weaning)) = weight at weaning
                       # i.e., weight gain at weaning
                       lG ~ sex + s(serum_brix_z) + s(brix_z) + mo(prior_events) 
                       + (1 | name_env) + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                       # K = growth rate (K > 0)
                       # We will assume that it depends on sex
                       # serum_brix_class and if the animal had previous diseases
                       lK ~ sex + s(serum_brix_z) + s(brix_z) + mo(prior_events) 
                       + (1 | name_env) + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                       nl = TRUE)
get_prior(weight.m1.formula, data = calf_ped_list[[1]], 
          data2 = list(A = A_matrix), family = student())
weight.m1.priors = c(prior(normal(3.4, 0.15), nlpar = "lW0", class = "b", 
                           coef = "Intercept"),
                     prior(normal(0, 0.1), nlpar = "lW0", class = "b"),
                     prior(exponential(10), nlpar = "lW0", class = "sd"),
                     
                     prior(normal(4.25, 0.15), nlpar = "lG", class = "b", 
                           coef = "Intercept"),
                     prior(normal(0, 0.1), nlpar = "lG", class = "b"),
                     prior(exponential(10), nlpar = "lG", class = "sd"),
                     prior(exponential(10), nlpar = "lG", class = "sds"),
                     
                     prior(normal(-3.5, 0.5), nlpar = "lK", class = "b", 
                           coef = "Intercept"),
                     prior(normal(0, 0.1), nlpar = "lK", class = "b"),
                     prior(exponential(10), nlpar = "lK", class = "sd"),
                     prior(exponential(10), nlpar = "lK", class = "sds"),
                     
                     prior(exponential(5), class = "sigma"),
                     prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu"))

weight.m1.prior = brm(formula = weight.m1.formula, data2 = list(A = A_matrix),
                      data = calf_ped_list[[1]], family = student(),
                      prior = weight.m1.priors, chains = 4, cores = 4,
                      iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, seed = 0, sample_prior = "only",
                      file = "out/brms/weight.m1.prior", file_refit = "on_change",
                      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.96, max_treedepth = 12),
                      backend = "cmdstanr", stan_model_args = stan_optimization_flags)

# lets do some prior predictive simulation
pp_check(weight.m1.prior, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(weight.m1.prior, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)
# seems ok. We can get extremes, which is good, but it seems to overlay nicely with the data. Lets run the model now

weight.m1.test = update(weight.m1.prior, sample_prior = "no",
                        file = "out/brms/weight.m1.test", cores = 4, seed = 0)

# Lets examine
summary(weight.m1.test)
# seems ok. We got a few transitions, but that is a complicated model. We need to simplify it
plot(weight.m1.test, ask = F)
rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics(weight.m1.test$fit)
# seems ok. Lets get posterior samples.
pp_check(weight.m1.test, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(weight.m1.test, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)
# R2 and loo dont work in this framework

# lets see the conditional effects
plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = weight.m1.test, predictor = "tstart", response = "body_weight",
               subset_var = "body_weight_subset",
               x_label = tstart.label, y_label = body.weight.label)
# we dont see the estimated line going to about 150 because these are missing data
# we will need to treat it in our model that will integrate with brix

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = weight.m1.test, predictor = "prior_events", response = "body_weight",
               subset_var = "body_weight_subset",
               x_label = prior_events.label, y_label = body.weight.label)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = weight.m1.test, predictor = "serum_brix_z", response = "body_weight",
               subset_var = "body_weight_subset",
               x_transform = function(x) x * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,
               x_label = serum.brix.label, y_label = body.weight.label)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[1]],
               model = weight.m1.test, predictor = "brix_z", response = "body_weight",
               subset_var = "body_weight_subset",
               x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center,
               x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = body.weight.label)
# name_env variance was estimate to shrunk to zero. I will remove it as to have
# a more parsimonious model
# The spline model is not that good, because it estimates that weight will decrease
# with age after a given threshold. I will try a more mechanistic model, similar
# to Brody (exponential)
```

```{r weight.m2.test}
# lets simplify it
```

```{r weight.health.brix.family}
# Unfortunatelly, we cant simply model a non-linear function in brms together
# with other things we have in our model. Hence, we will create a custom family
# and custm calculations to deal with different effects of serum brix and the
# propagation of this uncertainty
weight.healh.brix.family = custom_family("weight_health_brix",
                                         dpars = c("mu", "poor", "fair", "good",
                                                   
                                                   "serumbrixmu", "serumbrixsigma",
                                                   "serumbrixnu",
                                                   
                                                   "weightpoor", "weightfair",
                                                   "weightgood", "weightexcellent",
                                                   "weightsigma", "weightnu"),
                                         links = c(rep("identity", 5), "log", 
                                                   "logm1", rep("identity", 4),
                                                   "log", "logm1"),
                                         lb = c(rep(NA, 5), 0, 1, 
                                                rep(NA, 4), 0, 1),
                                         type = "int",
                                         vars = c(paste0("vint", 1:18), 
                                                  paste0("vreal", 1:6)),
                                         loop = FALSE)
weight.health.brix.stan.code = paste(readLines("stan/weight_health_brix_lpmf.stan", 
                                               warn = F), collapse = "\n")
weight.health.brix.stanvars = stanvar(scode = weight.health.brix.stan.code, 
                                      block = "functions")

```


```{r weight.health.brix.m1.test}
weight.health.brix.m1.formula = bf(disease_event | vint(animal_idx, serum_brix_observed,
                                                        animal_row_int,
                                                        serum_brix_class_id,
                                                        body_weight_subset_int,
                                                        idx_obs_poor_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_fair_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_good_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_exce_padded,
                                                        idx_miss_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_weight_poor_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_weight_fair_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_weight_good_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_weight_exce_padded,
                                                        idx_miss_weight_padded,
                                                        idx_obs_anim_padded,
                                                        idx_miss_anim_padded,
                                                        counts_padded) +
                                     vreal(log_interval_duration, serum_brix_z_fill,
                                           serum_brix_class_cuts_z_1, 
                                           serum_brix_class_cuts_z_2,
                                           serum_brix_class_cuts_z_3, 
                                           body_weight_filled) ~
                                     s(tstop) + management_stage + weight_at_birth_z +
                                     sex + prior_events + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                                   good ~ s(tstop, k = 7),
                                   fair ~ s(tstop, k = 3),
                                   poor ~ s(tstop, k = 3),
                                   # serum brix
                                   serumbrixmu ~ brix_z + weight_at_birth_z + sex,
                                   # weight
                                   nlf(weightpoor ~ exp(lWzero) + exp(lG + Gpoor) 
                                       * (1 - exp(-exp(lK + Kpoor) * tstart))),
                                   nlf(weightfair ~ exp(lWzero) + exp(lG + Gfair)
                                       * (1 - exp(-exp(lK + Kfair) * tstart))),
                                   nlf(weightgood ~ exp(lWzero) + exp(lG + Ggood) 
                                       * (1 - exp(-exp(lK + Kgood) * tstart))),
                                   nlf(weightexcellent ~ exp(lWzero) + exp(lG) 
                                       * (1 - exp(-exp(lK) * tstart))),
                                   lWzero ~ sex + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                                   lG  ~ sex + (1 | gr(name, cov = A)),
                                   lK  ~ sex,
                                   Gpoor ~ 1, Gfair ~ 1, Ggood ~ 1,
                                   Kpoor ~ 1, Kfair ~ 1, Kgood ~ 1,
                                   family = weight.healh.brix.family)

get_prior(weight.health.brix.m1.formula, data = calf_ped_list[[40]], data2 = list(A = A_matrix))
weight.health.brix.m1.priors = c(# Base Health
  prior(normal(-6.2, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.12), class = "b", coef = "prior_events"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sd"),
  
  # Class-specific Health
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "poor"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "poor"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sds", dpar = "poor"),
  
  prior(normal(-0.2, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "fair"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "fair"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sds", dpar = "fair"),
  
  prior(normal(-0.2, 0.2), class = "Intercept", dpar = "good"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "good"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sds", dpar = "good"),
  
  # Serum Brix
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "Intercept", dpar = "serumbrixmu"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", dpar = "serumbrixmu"),
  prior(gamma(2, 1), class = "serumbrixsigma"),
  prior(gamma(5, 0.5), class = "serumbrixnu"),
  
  # Weight Base
  prior(normal(3.4, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "lWzero"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.1), class = "b", nlpar = "lWzero"),
  prior(exponential(10), class = "sd", nlpar = "lWzero"),
  
  prior(normal(5.3, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "lG"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.1), class = "b", nlpar = "lG"),
  prior(exponential(10), class = "sd", nlpar = "lG"),
  
  prior(normal(-5.3, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "lK"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.1), class = "b", nlpar = "lK"),
  
  # Weight Class Offsets
  prior(normal(0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Gpoor"),
  prior(normal(-0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Gfair"),
  prior(normal(-0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Ggood"),
  
  prior(normal(0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Kpoor"),
  prior(normal(-0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Kfair"),
  prior(normal(-0.1, 0.2), coef = "Intercept", nlpar = "Kgood"),
  
  # Weight Observation
  prior(exponential(0.5), class = "weightsigma"),
  prior(gamma(2, 1), class = "weightnu"))

# prior predictive simulation is hard in such complicated model. We will trust the priors validated for
# the simpler models and go straight to the test model
weight.health.brix.m1.test = brm(formula = weight.health.brix.m1.formula, 
                                 stanvars = weight.health.brix.stanvars,
                                 data = calf_ped_list[[40]], # we are using 40 because we saw that it was the worst one
                                 data2 = list(A = A_matrix),
                                 prior = weight.health.brix.m1.priors, chains = 4, cores = 4,
                                 iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, init = 0.1,
                                 seed = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.96, max_treedepth = 12),
                                 file = "out/brms/weight.health.brix.m1.test", file_refit = "on_change",
                                 backend = "cmdstanr",
                                 stan_model_args = stan_optimization_flags)

# Lets examine
summary(weight.health.brix.m1.test)
# seems ok. Need to run the full model though
VarCorr(weight.health.brix.m1.test)
plot(weight.health.brix.m1.test, ask = F)
rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics(weight.health.brix.m1.test$fit)
# seems ok. Lets get posterior samples
weight.health.brix.m1.test.ppc = weight_health_brix_ppc(weight.health.brix.m1.test, calf_ped_list[[40]])

# lets see the conditional effects
plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "brix_z", response = "serum_brix_z",
               dpar = "serumbrixmu", external_mi_id = "name",
               external_mi_draws = weight.health.brix.m1.test.ppc$serum_mi_z,
               subset_var = "animal_row_int",
               x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center,
               y_transform = function(y) y * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,
               x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = serum.brix.label)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "weight_at_birth_z", response = "serum_brix_z",
               dpar = "serumbrixmu", external_mi_id = "name",
               external_mi_draws = weight.health.brix.m1.test.ppc$serum_mi_z,
               subset_var = "animal_row_int",
               x_transform = function(x) x * weight_at_birth_scale + weight_at_birth_center,
               y_transform = function(y) y * serum_brix_scale + serum_brix_center,
               x_label = weight.at.birth.label, y_label = serum.brix.label)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]], time_varying = "management_stage",
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "tstop", 
               response = "disease_event", risk_metric = "all",
               by = "serum_brix_class", reference = "excellent", contrast_layout = "all",
               x_label = tstop.label, y_label = health.by.response.label,
               curve_scale = "response", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "prior_events", response = "disease_event",
               dpar = "mu", y_transform = exp,
               x_label = prior_events.label, y_label = health.response.label,
               curve_scale = "response", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "prior_events", response = "disease_event",
               x_label = prior_events.label, y_label = health.link.label,
               curve_scale = "link", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "weight_at_birth_z", response = "disease_event",
               dpar = "mu", y_transform = exp,
               x_label = weight.at.birth.label, y_label = health.response.label,
               x_transform = function(x) x * weight_at_birth_scale + weight_at_birth_center,
               curve_scale = "response", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]],
               model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, predictor = "weight_at_birth_z", response = "disease_event",
               x_label = weight.at.birth.label, y_label = health.link.label,
               x_transform = function(x) x * weight_at_birth_scale + weight_at_birth_center,
               curve_scale = "link", show_points = F)

plot_mi_effect(data = calf_ped_list[[40]], model = weight.health.brix.m1.test,
               predictor = "tstart", response = "body_weight",
               subset_var = "body_weight_subset_int", by = "serum_brix_class",
               x_label = tstart.label, y_label = body.weight.by.label,
               point_alpha = 0.85)


# lets plot the probability of belonging to a serum brix class
plot_brix_prob(model = weight.health.brix.m1.test, 
                data = calf_ped_list[[40]], 
                predictor = "brix_z", 
                x_label = colostrum.brix.label, y_label = prob.label,
                x_transform = function(x) x * brix_scale + brix_center)
```
